verses.zh: 不從惡人的計謀， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐褻慢人的座位，
verses.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

verses.zh: 惟喜愛耶和華的律法， 晝夜思想， 這人便為有福！
verses.en: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

verses.zh: 他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁， 按時候結果子， 葉子也不枯乾。 凡他所做的盡都順利。
verses.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

verses.zh: 惡人並不是這樣， 乃像糠詷被風吹散。
verses.en: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

verses.zh: 因此，當審判的時候，惡人必站立不住； 罪人在義人的會中也是如此。
verses.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.zh: 因為耶和華知道義人的道路； 惡人的道路卻必滅亡。
verses.en: For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.zh: 外邦為甚麼爭鬧？ 萬民為甚麼謀算虛妄的事？
verses.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

verses.zh: 世上的君王一齊起來， 臣宰一同商議， 要敵擋耶和華並他的受膏者，
verses.en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,

verses.zh: 說：我們要掙開他們的捆綁， 脫去他們的繩索。
verses.en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

verses.zh: 那坐在天上的必發笑； 主必嗤笑他們。
verses.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

verses.zh: 那時，他要在怒中責備他們， 在烈怒中驚嚇他們，
verses.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

verses.zh: 說：我已經立我的君 在錫安－我的聖山上了。
verses.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

verses.zh: [受膏者說]：我要傳[聖]旨。 耶和華曾對我說：你是我的兒子， 我今日生你。
verses.en: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

verses.zh: 你求我，我就將列國賜你為基業， 將地極賜你為田產。
verses.en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

verses.zh: 你必用鐵杖打破他們； 你必將他們如同窯匠的瓦器摔碎。
verses.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

verses.zh: 現在，你們君王應當省悟！ 你們世上的審判官該受管教！
verses.en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

verses.zh: 當存畏懼事奉耶和華， 又當存戰兢而快樂。
verses.en: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

verses.zh: 當以嘴親子，恐怕他發怒， 你們便在道中滅亡， 因為他的怒氣快要發作。 凡投靠他的，都是有福的。
verses.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

verses.zh: 大衛逃避他兒子押沙龍的時候作的詩。 耶和華啊，我的敵人何其加增； 有許多人起來攻擊我。
verses.en: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

verses.zh: 有許多人議論我說： 他得不着上帝的幫助。 （細拉）
verses.en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

verses.zh: 但你－耶和華是我四圍的盾牌， 是我的榮耀，又是叫我抬起頭來的。
verses.en: But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

verses.zh: 我用我的聲音求告耶和華， 他就從他的聖山上應允我。 （細拉）
verses.en: I cried unto the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

verses.zh: 我躺下睡覺，我醒着， 耶和華都保佑我。
verses.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.

verses.zh: 雖有成萬的百姓來周圍攻擊我， 我也不怕。
verses.en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來！ 我的上帝啊，求你救我！ 因為你打了我一切仇敵的腮骨， 敲碎了惡人的牙齒。
verses.en: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

verses.zh: 救恩屬乎耶和華； 願你賜福給你的百姓。 （細拉）
verses.en: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 顯我為義的上帝啊， 我呼籲的時候，求你應允我！ 我在困苦中，你曾使我寬廣； 現在求你憐恤我，聽我的禱告！
verses.en: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

verses.zh: 你們這上流人哪，你們將我的尊榮變為羞辱[要到幾時呢]？ 你們喜愛虛妄，尋找虛假，要到幾時呢？ （細拉）
verses.en: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

verses.zh: 你們要知道，耶和華已經分別虔誠人歸他自己； 我求告耶和華，他必聽我。
verses.en: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the Lord will hear when I call unto him.

verses.zh: 你們應當畏懼，不可犯罪； 在床上的時候，要心裏思想，並要肅靜。 （細拉）
verses.en: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

verses.zh: 當獻上公義的祭， 又當倚靠耶和華。
verses.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.

verses.zh: 有許多人說：誰能指示我們甚麼好處？ 耶和華啊，求你仰起臉來，光照我們。
verses.en: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

verses.zh: 你使我心裏快樂， 勝過那豐收五穀新酒的人。
verses.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

verses.zh: 我必安然躺下睡覺， 因為獨有你－耶和華使我安然居住。
verses.en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用吹的樂器。 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的言語， 顧念我的心思！
verses.en: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.

verses.zh: 我的王我的上帝啊，求你垂聽我呼求的聲音！ 因為我向你祈禱。
verses.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，早晨你必聽我的聲音； 早晨我必向你陳明[我的心意]，並要警醒！
verses.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

verses.zh: 因為你不是喜悅惡事的上帝， 惡人不能與你同居。
verses.en: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

verses.zh: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前； 凡作孽的，都是你所恨惡的。
verses.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

verses.zh: 說謊言的，你必滅絕； 好流人血弄詭詐的，都為耶和華所憎惡。
verses.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

verses.zh: 至於我，我必憑你豐盛的慈愛進入你的居所； 我必存敬畏你的心向你的聖殿下拜。
verses.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你因我的仇敵，憑你的公義引領我， 使你的道路在我面前正直。
verses.en: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

verses.zh: 因為，他們的口中沒有誠實； 他們的心裏滿有邪惡； 他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓； 他們用舌頭諂媚人。
verses.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，求你定他們的罪！ 願他們因自己的計謀跌倒； 願你在他們許多的過犯中把他們逐出， 因為他們背叛了你。
verses.en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

verses.zh: 凡投靠你的，願他們喜樂，時常歡呼， 因為你護庇他們； 又願那愛你名的人都靠你歡欣。
verses.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

verses.zh: 因為你必賜福與義人； 耶和華啊，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面護衛他。
verses.en: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器，調用第八。 耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我， 也不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
verses.en: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你可憐我，因為我軟弱。 耶和華啊，求你醫治我，因為我的骨頭發戰。
verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

verses.zh: 我心也大大地驚惶。 耶和華啊，你要到幾時[才救我]呢？
verses.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你轉回搭救我！ 因你的慈愛拯救我。
verses.en: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

verses.zh: 因為，在死地無人記念你， 在陰間有誰稱謝你？
verses.en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

verses.zh: 我因唉哼而困乏； 我每夜流淚，把床榻漂起， 把褥子濕透。
verses.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

verses.zh: 我因憂愁眼睛乾癟， 又因我一切的敵人眼睛昏花。
verses.en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

verses.zh: 你們一切作孽的人，離開我吧！ 因為耶和華聽了我哀哭的聲音。
verses.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.zh: 耶和華聽了我的懇求； 耶和華必收納我的禱告。
verses.en: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.

verses.zh: 我的一切仇敵都必羞愧，大大驚惶； 他們必要退後，忽然羞愧。
verses.en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

verses.zh: 大衛指着便雅憫人古實的話，向耶和華唱的流離歌。 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我投靠你！ 求你救我脫離一切追趕我的人，將我救拔出來！
verses.en: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

verses.zh: 恐怕他們像獅子撕裂我， 甚至撕碎，無人搭救。
verses.en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我若行了這事， 若有罪孽在我手裏，
verses.en: O Lord my God, If I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.zh: 我若以惡報那與我交好的人－ 連那無故與我為敵的，我也救了他，
verses.en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

verses.zh: 就任憑仇敵追趕我，直到追上， 將我的性命踏在地下， 使我的榮耀歸於灰塵。 （細拉）
verses.en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你在怒中起來， 挺身而立，抵擋我敵人的暴怒！ 求你為我興起！你已經命定施行審判！
verses.en: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

verses.zh: 願眾民的會環繞你！ 願你從其上歸於高位！
verses.en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

verses.zh: 耶和華向眾民施行審判； 耶和華啊，求你按我的公義和我心中的純正判斷我。
verses.en: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

verses.zh: 願惡人的惡斷絕！ 願你堅立義人！ 因為公義的上帝察驗人的心腸肺腑。
verses.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

verses.zh: 上帝是我的盾牌； 他拯救心裏正直的人。
verses.en: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

verses.zh: 上帝是公義的審判者， 又是天天[向惡人]發怒的上帝。
verses.en: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

verses.zh: 若有人不回頭，他的刀必磨快， 弓必上弦，預備妥當了。
verses.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.zh: 他也預備了殺人的器械； 他所射的是火[箭]。
verses.en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

verses.zh: 試看惡人因奸惡而劬勞， 所懷的是毒害，所生的是虛假。
verses.en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

verses.zh: 他掘了坑，又挖深了， 竟掉在自己所挖的阱裏。
verses.en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

verses.zh: 他的毒害必臨到他自己的頭上； 他的強暴必落到他自己的腦袋上。
verses.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.zh: 我要照着耶和華的公義稱謝他， 歌頌耶和華至高者的名。
verses.en: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用迦特樂器。 耶和華－我們的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！ 你將你的榮耀彰顯於天。
verses.en: O Lord, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

verses.zh: 你因敵人的緣故， 從嬰孩和吃奶的口中， 建立了能力， 使仇敵和報仇的閉口無言。
verses.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.zh: 我觀看你指頭所造的天， 並你所陳設的月亮星宿，
verses.en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.zh: [便說]：人算甚麼，你竟顧念他！ 世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他！
verses.en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.zh: 你叫他比天使微小一點， 並賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕。
verses.en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

verses.zh: 你派他管理你手所造的， 使萬物，就是一切的牛羊、 田野的獸、空中的鳥、海裏的魚， 凡經行海道的，都服在他的腳下。
verses.en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我們的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！
verses.en: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用慕拉便。 我要一心稱謝耶和華； 我要傳揚你一切奇妙的作為。
verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

verses.zh: 我要因你歡喜快樂； 至高者啊，我要歌頌你的名！
verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

verses.zh: 我的仇敵轉身退去的時候， 他們一見你的面就跌倒滅亡。
verses.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

verses.zh: 因你已經為我伸冤，為我辨屈； 你坐在寶座上，按公義審判。
verses.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

verses.zh: 你曾斥責外邦，你曾滅絕惡人； 你曾塗抹他們的名，直到永永遠遠。
verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.zh: 仇敵到了盡頭； 他們被毀壞，直到永遠。 你拆毀他們的城邑， 連他們的名號都歸於無有。
verses.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

verses.zh: 惟耶和華坐着[為王]，直到永遠； 他已經為審判設擺他的寶座。
verses.en: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.zh: 他要按公義審判世界， 按正直判斷萬民。
verses.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.zh: 耶和華又要給受欺壓的人作高臺， 在患難的時候作高臺。
verses.en: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，認識你名的人要倚靠你， 因你沒有離棄尋求你的人。
verses.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

verses.zh: 應當歌頌居錫安的耶和華， 將他所行的傳揚在眾民中。
verses.en: Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

verses.zh: 因為那追討流人血之罪的－他記念受屈的人， 不忘記困苦人的哀求。
verses.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你是從死門把我提拔起來的； 求你憐恤我，看那恨我的人所加給我的苦難，
verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.zh: 好叫我述說你一切的美德； 我必在錫安城的門因你的救恩歡樂。
verses.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.zh: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中； 他們的腳在自己暗設的網羅裏纏住了。
verses.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.zh: 耶和華已將自己顯明了，他已施行審判； 惡人被自己手所做的纏住了 。 （細拉）
verses.en: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

verses.zh: 惡人，就是忘記上帝的外邦人， 都必歸到陰間。
verses.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

verses.zh: 窮乏人必不永久被忘； 困苦人的指望必不永遠落空。
verses.en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來，不容人得勝！ 願外邦人在你面前受審判！
verses.en: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你使外邦人恐懼； 願他們知道自己不過是人。 （細拉）
verses.en: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你為甚麼站在遠處？ 在患難的時候為甚麼隱藏？
verses.en: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

verses.zh: 惡人在驕橫中把困苦人追得火急； 願他們陷在自己所設的計謀裏。
verses.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

verses.zh: 因為惡人以心願自誇； 貪財的背棄耶和華，並且輕慢他。
verses.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.

verses.zh: 惡人面帶驕傲，[說]：耶和華必不追究； 他一切所想的都以為沒有上帝。
verses.en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

verses.zh: 凡他所做的，時常穩固； 你的審判超過他的眼界。 至於他一切的敵人， 他都向他們噴氣。
verses.en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

verses.zh: 他心裏說：我必不動搖， 世世代代不遭災難。
verses.en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

verses.zh: 他滿口是咒罵、詭詐、欺壓， 舌底是毒害、奸惡。
verses.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

verses.zh: 他在村莊埋伏等候； 他在隱密處殺害無辜的人。 他的眼睛窺探無倚無靠的人；
verses.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

verses.zh: 他埋伏在暗地，如獅子蹲在洞中。 他埋伏，要擄去困苦人； 他拉網，就把困苦人擄去。
verses.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

verses.zh: 他屈身蹲伏， 無倚無靠的人就倒在他爪牙 之下。
verses.en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

verses.zh: 他心裏說：上帝竟忘記了； 他掩面永不觀看。
verses.en: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來！ 上帝啊，求你舉手，不要忘記困苦人！
verses.en: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

verses.zh: 惡人為何輕慢上帝， 心裏說：你必不追究？
verses.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

verses.zh: [其實]你已經觀看； 因為奸惡毒害，你都看見了， 為要以手施行報應。 無倚無靠的人把[自己]交託你； 你向來是幫助孤兒的。
verses.en: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

verses.zh: 願你打斷惡人的膀臂； 至於壞人，願你追究他的惡，直到淨盡。
verses.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

verses.zh: 耶和華永永遠遠為王； 外邦人從他的地已經滅絕了。
verses.en: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，謙卑人的心願， 你早已知道。 你必預備他們的心， 也必側耳聽他們[的祈求]，
verses.en: Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

verses.zh: 為要給孤兒和受欺壓的人伸冤， 使強橫的人不再威嚇他們。
verses.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 我是投靠耶和華； 你們怎麼對我說：你當像鳥飛往你的山去。
verses.en: In the Lord put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

verses.zh: 看哪，惡人彎弓，把箭搭在弦上， 要在暗中射那心裏正直的人。
verses.en: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

verses.zh: 根基若毀壞， 義人還能做甚麼呢？
verses.en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

verses.zh: 耶和華在他的聖殿裏； 耶和華的寶座在天上； 他的慧眼察看世人。
verses.en: The Lord is in his holy temple, the Lord's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

verses.zh: 耶和華試驗義人； 惟有惡人和喜愛強暴的人，他心裏恨惡。
verses.en: The Lord trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

verses.zh: 他要向惡人密布網羅； 有烈火、硫磺、熱風，作他們杯中的分。
verses.en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.zh: 因為耶和華是公義的，他喜愛公義； 正直人必得見他的面。
verses.en: For the righteous Lord loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用第八。 耶和華啊，求你幫助，因虔誠人斷絕了； 世人中間的忠信人沒有了。
verses.en: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.zh: 人人向鄰舍說謊； 他們說話，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。
verses.en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

verses.zh: 凡油滑的嘴唇和誇大的舌頭， 耶和華必要剪除。
verses.en: The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

verses.zh: 他們曾說：我們必能以舌頭得勝； 我們的嘴唇是我們自己的， 誰能作我們的主呢？
verses.en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

verses.zh: 耶和華說：因為困苦人的冤屈 和貧窮人的歎息， 我現在要起來， 把他安置在他所切慕的穩妥之地。
verses.en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

verses.zh: 耶和華的言語是純淨的言語， 如同銀子在泥爐中煉過七次。
verses.en: The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你必保護他們； 你必保佑他們永遠脫離這世代的人。
verses.en: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

verses.zh: 下流人在世人中升高， 就有惡人到處遊行。
verses.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，你忘記我要到幾時呢？要到永遠嗎？ 你掩面不顧我要到幾時呢？
verses.en: How long wilt thou forget me, O Lord? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

verses.zh: 我心裏籌算，終日愁苦，要到幾時呢？ 我的仇敵升高壓制我，要到幾時呢？
verses.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

verses.zh: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你看顧我，應允我！ 使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；
verses.en: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

verses.zh: 免得我的仇敵說：我勝了他； 免得我的敵人在我搖動的時候喜樂。
verses.en: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

verses.zh: 但我倚靠你的慈愛； 我的心因你的救恩快樂。
verses.en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.zh: 我要向耶和華歌唱， 因他用厚恩待我。
verses.en: I will sing unto the Lord, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 愚頑人心裏說：沒有上帝。 他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的事； 沒有一個人行善。
verses.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

verses.zh: 耶和華從天上垂看世人， 要看有明白的沒有， 有尋求上帝的沒有。
verses.en: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

verses.zh: 他們都偏離正路， 一同變為污穢； 並沒有行善的， 連一個也沒有。
verses.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.zh: 作孽的都沒有知識嗎？ 他們吞吃我的百姓，[如同]吃飯一樣， 並不求告耶和華。
verses.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.

verses.zh: 他們在那裏大大地害怕， 因為上帝在義人的族類中。
verses.en: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.zh: 你們叫困苦人的謀算變為羞辱； 然而耶和華是他的避難所。
verses.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.

verses.zh: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。 耶和華救回他被擄的子民那時， 雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，誰能寄居你的帳幕？ 誰能住在你的聖山？
verses.en: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

verses.zh: 就是行為正直、做事公義、 心裏說實話的人。
verses.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

verses.zh: 他不以舌頭讒謗人， 不惡待朋友， 也不隨夥毀謗鄰里。
verses.en: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

verses.zh: 他眼中藐視匪類， 卻尊重那敬畏耶和華的人。 他發了誓，雖然自己吃虧也不更改。
verses.en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the Lord. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

verses.zh: 他不放債取利， 不受賄賂以害無辜。 行這些事的人必永不動搖。
verses.en: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

verses.zh: 大衛的金詩。 上帝啊，求你保佑我， 因為我投靠你。
verses.en: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

verses.zh: [我的心哪]，你曾對耶和華說：你是我的主； 我的好處不在你以外。
verses.en: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

verses.zh: 論到世上的聖民，他們又美又善， 是我最喜悅的。
verses.en: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

verses.zh: 以別[神]代替[耶和華]的， 他們的愁苦必加增； 他們所澆奠的血我不獻上； 我嘴唇也不提別神的名號。
verses.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

verses.zh: 耶和華是我的產業， 是我杯中的分； 我所得的，你為我持守。
verses.en: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

verses.zh: 用繩量給我的地界，坐落在佳美之處； 我的產業實在美好。
verses.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.zh: 我必稱頌那指教我的耶和華； 我的心腸在夜間也警戒我。
verses.en: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

verses.zh: 我將耶和華常擺在我面前， 因他在我右邊，我便不致搖動。
verses.en: I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

verses.zh: 因此，我的心歡喜，我的靈快樂； 我的肉身也要安然居住。
verses.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

verses.zh: 因為你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間， 也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。
verses.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

verses.zh: 你必將生命的道路指示我。 在你面前有滿足的喜樂； 在你右手中有永遠的福樂。
verses.en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

verses.zh: 大衛的祈禱。 耶和華啊，求你聽聞公義， 側耳聽我的呼籲！ 求你留心聽我這不出於詭詐嘴唇的祈禱！
verses.en: Hear the right, O Lord, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

verses.zh: 願我的判語從你面前發出； 願你的眼睛觀看公正。
verses.en: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

verses.zh: 你已經試驗我的心； 你在夜間鑒察我； 你熬煉我，卻找不着甚麼； 我立志叫我口中沒有過失。
verses.en: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

verses.zh: 論到人的行為，我藉着你嘴唇的言語自己謹守， 不行強暴人的道路。
verses.en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

verses.zh: 我的腳踏定了你的路徑； 我的兩腳未曾滑跌。
verses.en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，我曾求告你，因為你必應允我； 求你向我側耳，聽我的言語。
verses.en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

verses.zh: 求你顯出你奇妙的慈愛來； 你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脫離起來攻擊他們的人。
verses.en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

verses.zh: 求你保護我，如同保護眼中的瞳人； 將我隱藏在你翅膀的蔭下，
verses.en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

verses.zh: 使我脫離那欺壓我的惡人， 就是圍困我要害我命的仇敵。
verses.en: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

verses.zh: 他們的心被脂油包裹； 他們用口說驕傲的話。
verses.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

verses.zh: 他們圍困了我們的腳步； 他們瞪着眼，要把我們推倒在地。
verses.en: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

verses.zh: 他像獅子急要抓食， 又像少壯獅子蹲伏在暗處。
verses.en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你起來，前去迎敵，將他打倒！ 用你的刀救護我命脫離惡人。
verses.en: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你用手救我脫離[世]人， 脫離那只在今生有福分的世人！ 你把你的財寶充滿他們的肚腹； 他們因有兒女就心滿意足， 將其餘的財物留給他們的嬰孩。
verses.en: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

verses.zh: 至於我，我必在義中見你的面； 我醒了的時候，得見你的形像就心滿意足了。
verses.en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

verses.zh: 耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。當耶和華救他脫離一切仇敵和掃羅之手的日子，他向耶和華念這詩的話。說： 耶和華，我的力量啊，我愛你！
verses.en: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.

verses.zh: 耶和華是我的巖石，我的山寨，我的救主， 我的上帝，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌， 是拯救我的角，是我的高臺。
verses.en: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

verses.zh: 我要求告當讚美的耶和華； 這樣我必從仇敵手中被救出來。
verses.en: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.zh: 曾有死亡的繩索纏繞我， 匪類的急流使我驚懼，
verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

verses.zh: 陰間的繩索纏繞我， 死亡的網羅臨到我。
verses.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

verses.zh: 我在急難中求告耶和華， 向我的上帝呼求。 他從殿中聽了我的聲音； 我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。
verses.en: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

verses.zh: 那時，因他發怒，地就搖撼戰抖； 山的根基也震動搖撼。
verses.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

verses.zh: 從他鼻孔冒煙上騰； 從他口中發火焚燒，連炭也着了。
verses.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.zh: 他又使天下垂，親自降臨， 有黑雲在他腳下。
verses.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

verses.zh: 他坐着基路伯飛行； 他藉着風的翅膀快飛。
verses.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

verses.zh: 他以黑暗為藏身之處， 以水的黑暗、天空的厚雲為他四圍的行宮。
verses.en: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.zh: 因他面前的光輝， 他的厚雲行過便有冰雹火炭。
verses.en: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.zh: 耶和華也在天上打雷； 至高者發出聲音便有冰雹火炭。
verses.en: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.zh: 他射出箭來，使仇敵四散； 多多發出閃電，使他們擾亂。
verses.en: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你的斥責一發， 你鼻孔的氣一出， 海底就出現， 大地的根基也顯露。
verses.en: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

verses.zh: 他從高天伸手抓住我， 把我從大水中拉上來。
verses.en: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

verses.zh: 他救我脫離我的勁敵和那些恨我的人， 因為他們比我強盛。
verses.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.zh: 我遭遇災難的日子，他們來攻擊我； 但耶和華是我的倚靠。
verses.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.

verses.zh: 他又領我到寬闊之處； 他救拔我，因他喜悅我。
verses.en: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.zh: 耶和華按着我的公義報答我， 按着我手中的清潔賞賜我。
verses.en: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.zh: 因為我遵守了耶和華的道， 未曾作惡離開我的上帝。
verses.en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例我也未曾丟棄。
verses.en: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

verses.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己遠離我的罪孽。
verses.en: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

verses.zh: 所以，耶和華按我的公義， 按我在他眼前手中的清潔償還我。
verses.en: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.zh: 慈愛的人，你以慈愛待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他。
verses.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

verses.zh: 清潔的人，你以清潔待他； 乖僻的人，你以彎曲待他。
verses.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

verses.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。
verses.en: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

verses.zh: 你必點着我的燈； 耶和華－我的上帝必照明我的黑暗。
verses.en: For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.

verses.zh: 我藉着你衝入敵軍， 藉着我的上帝跳過牆垣。
verses.en: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

verses.zh: 至於上帝，他的道是完全的； 耶和華的話是煉淨的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他們的盾牌。
verses.en: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

verses.zh: 除了耶和華，誰是上帝呢？ 除了我們的上帝，誰是磐石呢？
verses.en: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?

verses.zh: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、 使我行為完全的，他是上帝。
verses.en: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

verses.zh: 他使我的腳快如母鹿的[蹄]， 又使我在高處安穩。
verses.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

verses.zh: 他教導我的手能以爭戰， 甚至我的膀臂能開銅弓。
verses.en: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

verses.zh: 你把你的救恩給我作盾牌； 你的右手扶持我； 你的溫和使我為大。
verses.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

verses.zh: 你使我腳下的地步寬闊； 我的腳未曾滑跌。
verses.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

verses.zh: 我要追趕我的仇敵，並要追上他們； 不將他們滅絕，我總不歸回。
verses.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

verses.zh: 我要打傷他們，使他們不能起來； 他們必倒在我的腳下。
verses.en: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

verses.zh: 因為你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能爭戰； 你也使那起來攻擊我的都服在我以下。
verses.en: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

verses.zh: 你又使我的仇敵在我面前轉背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
verses.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.zh: 他們呼求，卻無人拯救； 就是呼求耶和華，他也不應允。
verses.en: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.

verses.zh: 我搗碎他們，如同風前的灰塵， 倒出他們，如同街上的泥土。
verses.en: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

verses.zh: 你救我脫離百姓的爭競， 立我作列國的元首； 我素不認識的民必事奉我。
verses.en: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.zh: 他們一聽見我的名聲就必順從我； 外邦人要投降我。
verses.en: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

verses.zh: 外邦人要衰殘， 戰戰兢兢地出他們的營寨。
verses.en: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

verses.zh: 耶和華是活[神]。 願我的磐石被人稱頌； 願救我的上帝被人尊崇。
verses.en: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.zh: 這位上帝，就是那為我伸冤、 使眾民服在我以下的。
verses.en: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

verses.zh: 你救我脫離仇敵， 又把我舉起，高過那些起來攻擊我的； 你救我脫離強暴的人。
verses.en: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，因此我要在外邦中稱謝你， 歌頌你的名。
verses.en: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

verses.zh: 耶和華賜極大的救恩給他[所立]的王， 施慈愛給他的受膏者， 就是給大衛和他的後裔，直到永遠。
verses.en: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 諸天述說上帝的榮耀； 穹蒼傳揚他的手段。
verses.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

verses.zh: 這日到那日發出言語； 這夜到那夜傳出知識。
verses.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

verses.zh: 無言無語， 也無聲音可聽。
verses.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

verses.zh: 它的量帶通遍天下， 它的言語傳到地極。 上帝在其間為太陽安設帳幕；
verses.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

verses.zh: 太陽如同新郎出洞房， 又如勇士歡然奔路。
verses.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

verses.zh: 它從天這邊出來，繞到天那邊， 沒有一物被隱藏不得它的熱氣。
verses.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

verses.zh: 耶和華的律法全備，能甦醒人心； 耶和華的法度確定，能使愚人有智慧。
verses.en: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.zh: 耶和華的訓詞正直，能快活人的心； 耶和華的命令清潔，能明亮人的眼目。
verses.en: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.zh: 耶和華的道理潔淨，存到永遠； 耶和華的典章真實，全然公義－
verses.en: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.

verses.zh: 都比金子可羨慕，且比極多的精金可羨慕； 比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。
verses.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.zh: 況且你的僕人因此受警戒， 守着這些便有大賞。
verses.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

verses.zh: 誰能知道[自己的]錯失呢？ 願你赦免我隱而未現的[過錯]。
verses.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

verses.zh: 求你攔阻僕人不犯任意妄為的罪， 不容這罪轄制我， 我便完全，免犯大罪。
verses.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我的磐石，我的救贖主啊， 願我口中的言語、心裏的意念在你面前蒙悅納。
verses.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 願耶和華在你遭難的日子應允你； 願名為雅各上帝的高舉你。
verses.en: The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

verses.zh: 願他從聖所救助你， 從錫安堅固你，
verses.en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

verses.zh: 記念你的一切供獻， 悅納你的燔祭， （細拉）
verses.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

verses.zh: 將你心所願的賜給你， 成就你的一切籌算。
verses.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.zh: 我們要因你的救恩誇勝， 要奉我們上帝的名豎立旌旗。 願耶和華成就你一切所求的！
verses.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.zh: 現在我知道耶和華救護他的受膏者， 必從他的聖天上應允他， 用右手的能力救護他。
verses.en: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.zh: 有人[靠]車，有人[靠]馬， 但我們要提到耶和華－我們上帝的名。
verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Lord our God.

verses.zh: 他們都屈身仆倒， 我們卻起來，立得正直。
verses.en: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.zh: 求耶和華施行拯救； 我們呼求的時候，願王應允我們！
verses.en: Save, Lord: let the king hear us when we call.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，王必因你的能力歡喜； 因你的救恩，他的快樂何其大！
verses.en: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Lord; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

verses.zh: 他心裏所願的，你已經賜給他； 他嘴唇所求的，你未嘗不應允。 （細拉）
verses.en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.zh: 你以美福迎接他， 把精金的冠冕戴在他頭上。
verses.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.zh: 他向你求壽，你便賜給他， 就是日子長久，直到永遠。
verses.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

verses.zh: 他因你的救恩大有榮耀； 你又將尊榮威嚴加在他身上。
verses.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

verses.zh: 你使他有洪福，直到永遠， 又使他在你面前歡喜快樂。
verses.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

verses.zh: 王倚靠耶和華， 因至高者的慈愛必不搖動。
verses.en: For the king trusteth in the Lord, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.zh: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敵； 你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。
verses.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

verses.zh: 你發怒的時候，要使他們如在炎熱的火爐中。 耶和華要在他的震怒中吞滅他們； 那火要把他們燒盡了。
verses.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.zh: 你必從世上滅絕他們的子孫， 從人間滅絕他們的後裔。
verses.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.zh: 因為他們有意加害於你； 他們想出計謀，卻不能做成。
verses.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

verses.zh: 你必使他們轉背逃跑， 向他們的臉搭箭在弦。
verses.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，願你因自己的能力顯為至高！ 這樣，我們就唱詩，歌頌你的大能。
verses.en: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用朝鹿。 我的上帝，我的上帝！為甚麼離棄我？ [為甚麼]遠離不救我？不聽我唉哼的言語？
verses.en: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

verses.zh: 我的上帝啊，我白日呼求，你不應允， 夜間呼求，並不住聲。
verses.en: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

verses.zh: 但你是聖潔的， 是用以色列的讚美為寶座的。
verses.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

verses.zh: 我們的祖宗倚靠你； 他們倚靠你，你便解救他們。
verses.en: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

verses.zh: 他們哀求你，便蒙解救； 他們倚靠你，就不羞愧。
verses.en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

verses.zh: 但我是蟲，不是人， 被眾人羞辱，被百姓藐視。
verses.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.zh: 凡看見我的都嗤笑我； 他們撇嘴搖頭，[說]：
verses.en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

verses.zh: 他把[自己]交託耶和華，耶和華可以救他吧！ 耶和華既喜悅他，可以搭救他吧！
verses.en: He trusted on the Lord that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

verses.zh: 但你是叫我出母腹的； 我在母懷裏，你就使我有倚靠的心。
verses.en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

verses.zh: 我自出母胎就被交在你手裏； 從我母親生我，你就是我的上帝。
verses.en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

verses.zh: 求你不要遠離我！ 因為急難臨近了，沒有人幫助我。
verses.en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

verses.zh: 有許多公牛圍繞我， 巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。
verses.en: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

verses.zh: 牠們向我張口， 好像抓撕吼叫的獅子。
verses.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

verses.zh: 我如水被倒出來； 我的骨頭都脫了節； 我心在我裏面如蠟鎔化。
verses.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

verses.zh: 我的精力枯乾，如同瓦片； 我的舌頭貼在我牙床上。 你將我安置在死地的塵土中。
verses.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

verses.zh: 犬類圍着我，惡黨環繞我； 他們扎了我的手，我的腳。
verses.en: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

verses.zh: 我的骨頭，我都能數過； 他們瞪着眼看我。
verses.en: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

verses.zh: 他們分我的外衣， 為我的裏衣拈鬮。
verses.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要遠離我！ 我的救主啊，求你快來幫助我！
verses.en: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

verses.zh: 求你救我的靈魂脫離刀劍， 救我的生命脫離犬類，
verses.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

verses.zh: 救我脫離獅子的口； 你已經應允我，使我脫離野牛的角。
verses.en: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.zh: 我要將你的名傳與我的弟兄， 在會中我要讚美你。
verses.en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

verses.zh: 你們敬畏耶和華的人要讚美他！ 雅各的後裔都要榮耀他！ 以色列的後裔都要懼怕他！
verses.en: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

verses.zh: 因為他沒有藐視憎惡受苦的人， 也沒有向他掩面； 那受苦之人呼籲的時候，他就垂聽。
verses.en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

verses.zh: 我在大會中讚美你的話是從你而來的； 我要在敬畏耶和華的人面前還我的願。
verses.en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

verses.zh: 謙卑的人必吃得飽足； 尋求耶和華的人必讚美他。 願你們的心永遠活着！
verses.en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the Lord that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

verses.zh: 地的四極都要想念耶和華，並且歸順他； 列國的萬族都要在你面前敬拜。
verses.en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

verses.zh: 因為國權是耶和華的； 他是管理萬國的。
verses.en: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and he is the governor among the nations.

verses.zh: 地上一切豐肥的人必吃喝而敬拜； 凡下到塵土中－不能存活自己性命的人 －都要在他面前下拜。
verses.en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

verses.zh: 他必有後裔事奉他； 主所行的事必傳與後代。
verses.en: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

verses.zh: 他們必來把他的公義傳給將要生的民， 言明這事是他所行的。
verses.en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華是我的牧者， 我必不致缺乏。
verses.en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.zh: 他使我躺臥在青草地上， 領我在可安歇的水邊。
verses.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

verses.zh: 他使我的靈魂甦醒， 為自己的名引導我走義路。
verses.en: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

verses.zh: 我雖然行過死蔭的[幽]谷， 也不怕遭害， 因為你與我同在； 你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
verses.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

verses.zh: 在我敵人面前，你為我擺設筵席； 你用油膏了我的頭，使我的[福]杯滿溢。
verses.en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

verses.zh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈愛隨着我； 我且要住在耶和華的殿中，直到永遠。
verses.en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 地和其中所充滿的， 世界和住在其間的，都屬耶和華。
verses.en: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.zh: 他把地建立在海上， 安定在大水之上。
verses.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

verses.zh: 誰能登耶和華的山？ 誰能站在他的聖所？
verses.en: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.zh: 就是手潔心清，不向虛妄， 起誓不懷詭詐的人。
verses.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

verses.zh: 他必蒙耶和華賜福， 又蒙救他的上帝使他成義。
verses.en: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.zh: 這是尋求耶和華的族類， 是尋求你面的雅各。 （細拉）
verses.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

verses.zh: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！ 永久的門戶，你們要被舉起！ 那榮耀的王將要進來！
verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.zh: 榮耀的王是誰呢？ 就是有力有能的耶和華， 在戰場上有能的耶和華！
verses.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

verses.zh: 眾城門哪，你們要抬起頭來！ 永久的門戶，你們要把頭抬起！ 那榮耀的王將要進來！
verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.zh: 榮耀的王是誰呢？ 萬軍之耶和華， 他是榮耀的王！ （細拉）
verses.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，我的心仰望你。
verses.en: Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.zh: 我的上帝啊，我素來倚靠你； 求你不要叫我羞愧， 不要叫我的仇敵向我誇勝。
verses.en: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.zh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧； 惟有那無故行奸詐的必要羞愧。
verses.en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指示我， 將你的路教訓我！
verses.en: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.

verses.zh: 求你以你的真理引導我，教訓我， 因為你是救我的上帝。 我終日等候你。
verses.en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你記念你的憐憫和慈愛， 因為這是亙古以來所常有的。
verses.en: Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

verses.zh: 求你不要記念我幼年的罪愆和我的過犯； 耶和華啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈愛記念我。
verses.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O Lord.

verses.zh: 耶和華是良善正直的， 所以他必指示罪人走[正]路。
verses.en: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

verses.zh: 他必按公平引領謙卑人， 將他的道教訓他們。
verses.en: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

verses.zh: 凡遵守他的約和他法度的人， 耶和華都以慈愛誠實待他。
verses.en: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪， 因為我的罪重大。
verses.en: For thy name's sake, O Lord, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

verses.zh: 誰敬畏耶和華， 耶和華必指示他當選擇的道路。
verses.en: What man is he that feareth the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

verses.zh: 他必安然居住； 他的後裔必承受地土。
verses.en: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

verses.zh: 耶和華與敬畏他的人親密； 他必將自己的約指示他們。
verses.en: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

verses.zh: 我的眼目時常仰望耶和華， 因為他必將我的腳從網裏拉出來。
verses.en: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.zh: 求你轉向我，憐恤我， 因為我是孤獨困苦。
verses.en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.zh: 我心裏的愁苦甚多， 求你救我脫離我的禍患。
verses.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

verses.zh: 求你看顧我的困苦，我的艱難， 赦免我一切的罪。
verses.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

verses.zh: 求你察看我的仇敵， 因為他們人多，並且痛痛地恨我。
verses.en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

verses.zh: 求你保護我的性命，搭救我， 使我不致羞愧，因為我投靠你。
verses.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

verses.zh: 願純全、正直保守我， 因為我等候你。
verses.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，求你救贖以色列脫離他一切的愁苦。
verses.en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，求你為我伸冤， 因我向來行事純全； 我又倚靠耶和華，並不搖動。
verses.en: Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你察看我，試驗我， 熬煉我的肺腑心腸。
verses.en: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.zh: 因為你的慈愛常在我眼前， 我也按你的真理而行。
verses.en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

verses.zh: 我沒有和虛謊人同坐， 也不與瞞哄人的同群。
verses.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.zh: 我恨惡惡人的會， 必不與惡人同坐。
verses.en: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我要洗手表明無辜， 才環繞你的祭壇；
verses.en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:

verses.zh: 我好發稱謝的聲音， 也要述說你一切奇妙的作為。
verses.en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我喜愛你所住的殿 和你顯榮耀的居所。
verses.en: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

verses.zh: 不要把我的靈魂和罪人一同除掉； 不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。
verses.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

verses.zh: 他們的手中有奸惡， 右手滿有賄賂。
verses.en: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.zh: 至於我，卻要行事純全； 求你救贖我，憐恤我！
verses.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.zh: 我的腳站在平坦地方； 在眾會中我要稱頌耶和華！
verses.en: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華是我的亮光，是我的拯救， 我還怕誰呢？ 耶和華是我性命的保障， 我還懼誰呢？
verses.en: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.zh: 那作惡的就是我的仇敵， 前來吃我肉的時候就絆跌仆倒。
verses.en: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

verses.zh: 雖有軍兵安營攻擊我，我的心也不害怕； 雖然興起刀兵攻擊我，我必仍舊安穩。
verses.en: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

verses.zh: 有一件事，我曾求耶和華，我仍要尋求： 就是一生一世住在耶和華的殿中， 瞻仰他的榮美，在他的殿裏求問。
verses.en: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to enquire in his temple.

verses.zh: 因為我遭遇患難，他必暗暗地保守我； 在他亭子裏，把我藏在他帳幕的隱密處， 將我高舉在磐石上。
verses.en: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

verses.zh: 現在我得以昂首，高過四面的仇敵。 我要在他的帳幕裏歡然獻祭； 我要唱詩歌頌耶和華。
verses.en: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我用聲音呼籲的時候，求你垂聽； 並求你憐恤我，應允我。
verses.en: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

verses.zh: [你說]：你們當尋求我的面。 那時我心向你說：耶和華啊， 你的面我正要尋求。
verses.en: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.

verses.zh: 不要向我掩面。 不要發怒趕逐僕人， 你向來是幫助我的。 救我的上帝啊，不要丟掉我， 也不要離棄我。
verses.en: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.zh: 我父母離棄我， 耶和華必收留我。
verses.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我， 因我仇敵的緣故引導我走平坦的路。
verses.en: Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

verses.zh: 求你不要把我交給敵人，遂其所願； 因為妄作見證的和口吐凶言的，起來攻擊我。
verses.en: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

verses.zh: 我若不信在活人之地得見耶和華的恩惠， [就早已喪膽了]。
verses.en: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.zh: 要等候耶和華！ 當壯膽，堅固你的心！ 我再說，要等候耶和華！
verses.en: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，我要求告你！ 我的磐石啊，不要向我緘默！ 倘若你向我閉口， 我就如將死的人一樣。
verses.en: Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.zh: 我呼求你，向你至聖所舉手的時候， 求你垂聽我懇求的聲音！
verses.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

verses.zh: 不要把我和惡人並作孽的一同除掉； 他們與鄰舍說和平話，心裏卻是奸惡。
verses.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

verses.zh: 願你按着他們所做的， 並他們所行的惡事待他們。 願你照着他們手所做的待他們， 將他們所應得的報應加給他們。
verses.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

verses.zh: 他們既然不留心耶和華所行的和他手所做的， 他就必毀壞他們，不建立他們。
verses.en: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

verses.zh: 耶和華是應當稱頌的， 因為他聽了我懇求的聲音。
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.zh: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的盾牌； 我心裏倚靠他就得幫助。 所以我心中歡樂， 我必用詩歌頌讚他。
verses.en: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

verses.zh: 耶和華是他百姓的力量， 又是他受膏者得救的保障。
verses.en: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

verses.zh: 求你拯救你的百姓，賜福給你的產業， 牧養他們，扶持他們，直到永遠。
verses.en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 上帝的眾子啊，你們要將榮耀、能力歸給耶和華， 歸給耶和華！
verses.en: Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

verses.zh: 要將耶和華的名所當得的榮耀歸給他， 以聖潔的妝飾敬拜耶和華。
verses.en: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聲音發在水上； 榮耀的上帝打雷， 耶和華打雷在大水之上。
verses.en: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聲音大有能力； 耶和華的聲音滿有威嚴。
verses.en: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聲音震破香柏樹； 耶和華震碎黎巴嫩的香柏樹。
verses.en: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.zh: 他也使之跳躍如牛犢， 使黎巴嫩和西連跳躍如野牛犢。
verses.en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聲音使火焰分岔。
verses.en: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聲音震動曠野； 耶和華震動加低斯的曠野。
verses.en: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聲音驚動母鹿落胎， 樹木也脫落淨光。 凡在他殿中的，都稱說[他的]榮耀。
verses.en: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

verses.zh: 洪水泛濫之時，耶和華坐着[為王]； 耶和華坐着為王，直到永遠。
verses.en: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.

verses.zh: 耶和華必賜力量給他的百姓； 耶和華必賜平安的福給他的百姓。
verses.en: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.

verses.zh: 大衛在獻殿的時候，作這詩歌。 耶和華啊，我要尊崇你， 因為你曾提拔我，不叫仇敵向我誇耀。
verses.en: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我的上帝啊， 我曾呼求你，你醫治了我。
verses.en: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你曾把我的靈魂從陰間救上來， 使我存活，不至於下坑。
verses.en: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們要歌頌他， 稱讚他可記念的聖[名]。
verses.en: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.zh: 因為，他的怒氣不過是轉眼之間； 他的恩典乃是一生之久。 一宿雖然有哭泣， 早晨便必歡呼。
verses.en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

verses.zh: 至於我，我凡事平順，便說： 我永不動搖。
verses.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你曾施恩，叫我的[江]山穩固； 你掩了面，我就驚惶。
verses.en: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我曾求告你； 我向耶和華懇求，[說]：
verses.en: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.

verses.zh: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有甚麼益處呢？ 塵土豈能稱讚你，傳說你的誠實嗎？
verses.en: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，憐恤我！ 耶和華啊，求你幫助我！
verses.en: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.

verses.zh: 你已將我的哀哭變為跳舞， 將我的麻衣脫去，給我披上喜樂，
verses.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.zh: 好叫我的靈歌頌你，並不住聲。 耶和華－我的上帝啊，我要稱謝你，直到永遠！
verses.en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 耶和華啊，我投靠你； 求你使我永不羞愧； 憑你的公義搭救我！
verses.en: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

verses.zh: 求你側耳而聽， 快快救我！ 作我堅固的磐石， 拯救我的保障！
verses.en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

verses.zh: 因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨； 所以，求你為你名的緣故引導我，指點我。
verses.en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.zh: 求你救我脫離人為我暗設的網羅， 因為你是我的保障。
verses.en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

verses.zh: 我將我的靈魂交在你手裏； 耶和華誠實的上帝啊，你救贖了我。
verses.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

verses.zh: 我恨惡那信奉虛無[之神]的人； 我卻倚靠耶和華。
verses.en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.

verses.zh: 我要為你的慈愛高興歡喜； 因為你見過我的困苦，知道我心中的艱難。
verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

verses.zh: 你未曾把我交在仇敵手裏； 你使我的腳站在寬闊之處。
verses.en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我， 因為我在急難之中； 我的眼睛因憂愁而乾癟， 連我的身心也不安舒。
verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

verses.zh: 我的生命為愁苦所消耗； 我的年歲為歎息所曠廢。 我的力量因我的罪孽衰敗； 我的骨頭也枯乾。
verses.en: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

verses.zh: 我因一切敵人成了羞辱， 在我的鄰舍跟前更甚； 那認識我的都懼怕我， 在外頭看見我的都躲避我。
verses.en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

verses.zh: 我被人忘記，如同死人，無人記念； 我好像破碎的器皿。
verses.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

verses.zh: 我聽見了許多人的讒謗， 四圍都是驚嚇； 他們一同商議攻擊我的時候， 就圖謀要害我的性命。
verses.en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我仍舊倚靠你； 我說：你是我的上帝。
verses.en: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.

verses.zh: 我終身的事在你手中； 求你救我脫離仇敵的手和那些逼迫我的人。
verses.en: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

verses.zh: 求你使你的臉光照僕人， 憑你的慈愛拯救我。
verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你叫我不致羞愧， 因為我曾呼籲你； 求你使惡人羞愧， 使他們在陰間緘默無聲。
verses.en: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

verses.zh: 那撒謊的人逞驕傲輕慢， 出狂妄的話攻擊義人； 願他的嘴啞而無言。
verses.en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

verses.zh: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你為他們所積存的， 在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！
verses.en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

verses.zh: 你必把他們藏在你面前的隱密處， 免得遇見人的計謀； 你必暗暗地保守他們在亭子裏， 免受口舌的爭鬧。
verses.en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.zh: 耶和華是應當稱頌的， 因為他在堅固城裏向我施展奇妙的慈愛。
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

verses.zh: 至於我，我曾急促地說： 我從你眼前被隔絕。 然而，我呼求你的時候， 你仍聽我懇求的聲音。
verses.en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們都要愛他！ 耶和華保護誠實人， 足足報應行事驕傲的人。
verses.en: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.zh: 凡仰望耶和華的人， 你們都要壯膽，堅固你們的心！
verses.en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.

verses.zh: 大衛的訓誨詩。 得赦免其過、遮蓋其罪的， 這人是有福的！
verses.en: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.zh: 凡心裏沒有詭詐、耶和華不算為有罪的， 這人是有福的！
verses.en: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.zh: 我閉口不認罪的時候， 因終日唉哼而骨頭枯乾。
verses.en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

verses.zh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重； 我的精液耗盡，如同夏天的乾旱。 （細拉）
verses.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.zh: 我向你陳明我的罪， 不隱瞞我的惡。 我說：我要向耶和華承認我的過犯， 你就赦免我的罪惡。 （細拉）
verses.en: I acknowledge my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.zh: 為此，凡虔誠人都當趁你可尋找的時候禱告你； 大水泛溢的時候，必不能到他那裏。
verses.en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.zh: 你是我藏身之處； 你必保佑我脫離苦難， 以得救的樂歌四面環繞我。 （細拉）
verses.en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.zh: 我要教導你，指示你當行的路； 我要定睛在你身上勸戒你。
verses.en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

verses.zh: 你不可像那無知的騾馬， 必用嚼環轡頭勒住牠； 不然，就不能馴服。
verses.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

verses.zh: 惡人必多受苦楚； 惟獨倚靠耶和華的必有慈愛四面環繞他。
verses.en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.

verses.zh: 你們義人應當靠耶和華歡喜快樂； 你們心裏正直的人都當歡呼。
verses.en: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.zh: 義人哪，你們應當靠耶和華歡樂； 正直人的讚美是合宜的。
verses.en: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

verses.zh: 你們應當彈琴稱謝耶和華， 用十弦瑟歌頌他。
verses.en: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

verses.zh: 應當向他唱新歌， 彈得巧妙，聲音洪亮。
verses.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

verses.zh: 因為耶和華的言語正直； 凡他所做的盡都誠實。
verses.en: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.

verses.zh: 他喜愛仁義公平； 遍地滿了耶和華的慈愛。
verses.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

verses.zh: 諸天藉耶和華的命而造； 萬象藉他口中的氣而成。
verses.en: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.zh: 他聚集海水如壘， 收藏深洋在庫房。
verses.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

verses.zh: 願全地都敬畏耶和華！ 願世上的居民都懼怕他！
verses.en: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.zh: 因為他說有，就有， 命立，就立。
verses.en: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.zh: 耶和華使列國的籌算歸於無有， 使眾民的思念無有功效。
verses.en: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

verses.zh: 耶和華的籌算永遠立定； 他心中的思念萬代常存。
verses.en: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.zh: 以耶和華為上帝的，那國是有福的！ 他所揀選為自己產業的，那民是有福的！
verses.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.zh: 耶和華從天上觀看； 他看見一切的世人。
verses.en: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

verses.zh: 從他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民－
verses.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.zh: 他是那造成他們眾人心的， 留意他們一切作為的。
verses.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

verses.zh: 君王不能因兵多得勝； 勇士不能因力大得救。
verses.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

verses.zh: 靠馬得救是枉然的； 馬也不能因力大救人。
verses.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

verses.zh: 耶和華的眼目看顧敬畏他的人 和仰望他慈愛的人，
verses.en: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

verses.zh: 要救他們的命脫離死亡， 並使他們在饑荒中存活。
verses.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.zh: 我們的心向來等候耶和華； 他是我們的幫助，我們的盾牌。
verses.en: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.

verses.zh: 我們的心必靠他歡喜， 因為我們向來倚靠他的聖名。
verses.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你照着我們所仰望你的， 向我們施行慈愛！
verses.en: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

verses.zh: 大衛在亞比米勒面前裝瘋，被他趕出去，就作這詩。 我要時時稱頌耶和華； 讚美他的話必常在我口中。
verses.en: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.zh: 我的心必因耶和華誇耀； 謙卑人聽見就要喜樂。
verses.en: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.zh: 你們和我當稱耶和華為大， 一同高舉他的名。
verses.en: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.zh: 我曾尋求耶和華，他就應允我， 救我脫離了一切的恐懼。
verses.en: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.zh: 凡仰望他的，便有光榮； 他們的臉必不蒙羞。
verses.en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

verses.zh: 我這困苦人呼求，耶和華便垂聽， 救我脫離一切患難。
verses.en: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.zh: 耶和華的使者在敬畏他的人四圍安營， 搭救他們。
verses.en: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

verses.zh: 你們要嘗嘗[主恩的滋味]，便知道他是美善； 投靠他的人有福了！
verses.en: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

verses.zh: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們當敬畏他， 因敬畏他的一無所缺。
verses.en: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.zh: 少壯獅子還缺食忍餓， 但尋求耶和華的甚麼好處都不缺。
verses.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.

verses.zh: 眾弟子啊，你們當來聽我的話！ 我要將敬畏耶和華的道教訓你們。
verses.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.zh: 有何人喜好存活， 愛慕[長]壽，得享美福，
verses.en: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

verses.zh: 就要禁止舌頭不出惡言， 嘴唇不說詭詐的話。
verses.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.zh: 要離惡行善， 尋求和睦，一心追趕。
verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.zh: 耶和華的眼目看顧義人； 他的耳朵聽他們的呼求。
verses.en: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

verses.zh: 耶和華向行惡的人變臉， 要從世上除滅他們的名號。
verses.en: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.zh: [義人]呼求，耶和華聽見了， 便救他們脫離一切患難。
verses.en: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.zh: 耶和華靠近傷心的人， 拯救靈性痛悔的人。
verses.en: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.zh: 義人多有苦難， 但耶和華救他脫離這一切，
verses.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.

verses.zh: 又保全他一身的骨頭， 連一根也不折斷。
verses.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.zh: 惡必害死惡人； 恨惡義人的，必被定罪。
verses.en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

verses.zh: 耶和華救贖他僕人的靈魂； 凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
verses.en: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華啊，與我相爭的，求你與他們相爭！ 與我相戰的，求你與他們相戰！
verses.en: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

verses.zh: 拿着大小的盾牌， 起來幫助我。
verses.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

verses.zh: 抽出槍來，擋住那追趕我的； 求你對我的靈魂說：我是拯救你的。
verses.en: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

verses.zh: 願那尋索我命的，蒙羞受辱！ 願那謀害我的，退後羞愧！
verses.en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

verses.zh: 願他們像風前的糠， 有耶和華的使者趕逐他們。
verses.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase them.

verses.zh: 願他們的道路又暗又滑， 有耶和華的使者追趕他們。
verses.en: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.

verses.zh: 因他們無故地為我暗設網羅， 無故地挖坑，要害我的性命。
verses.en: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

verses.zh: 願災禍忽然臨到他身上！ 願他暗設的網纏住自己！ 願他落在其中遭災禍！
verses.en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

verses.zh: 我的心必靠耶和華快樂， 靠他的救恩高興。
verses.en: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.zh: 我的骨頭都要說： 耶和華啊，誰能像你 救護困苦人脫離那比他強壯的， 救護困苦窮乏人脫離那搶奪他的？
verses.en: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

verses.zh: 凶惡的見證人起來， 盤問我所不知道的事。
verses.en: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

verses.zh: 他們向我以惡報善， 使我的靈魂孤苦。
verses.en: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

verses.zh: 至於我，當他們有病的時候， 我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心； 我所求的都歸到自己的懷中。
verses.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

verses.zh: 我這樣行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄； 我屈身悲哀，如同人為母親哀痛。
verses.en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

verses.zh: 我在患難中，他們卻歡喜，大家聚集。 我所不認識的那些下流人聚集攻擊我； 他們不住地把我撕裂。
verses.en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

verses.zh: 他們如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。
verses.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.zh: 主啊，你看着不理要到幾時呢？ 求你救我的靈魂脫離他們的殘害！ 救我的生命脫離少壯獅子！
verses.en: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

verses.zh: 我在大會中要稱謝你， 在眾民中要讚美你。
verses.en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

verses.zh: 求你不容那無理與我為仇的向我誇耀！ 不容那無故恨我的向我擠眼！
verses.en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

verses.zh: 因為他們不說和平話， 倒想出詭詐的言語害地上的安靜人。
verses.en: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

verses.zh: 他們大大張口攻擊我，說： 阿哈，阿哈，我們的眼已經看見了！
verses.en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你已經看見了，求你不要閉口！ 主啊，求你不要遠離我！
verses.en: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.zh: 我的上帝我的主啊，求你奮興醒起， 判清我的事，伸明我的冤！
verses.en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你按你的公義判斷我， 不容他們向我誇耀！
verses.en: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.zh: 不容他們心裏說：阿哈，遂我們的心願了！ 不容他們說：我們已經把他吞了！
verses.en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

verses.zh: 願那喜歡我遭難的一同抱愧蒙羞！ 願那向我妄自尊大的披慚愧，蒙羞辱！
verses.en: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

verses.zh: 願那喜悅我冤屈得伸的歡呼快樂； 願他們常說：當尊耶和華為大！ 耶和華喜悅他的僕人平安。
verses.en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

verses.zh: 我的舌頭要終日論說你的公義， 時常讚美你。
verses.en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.zh: 耶和華的僕人大衛的詩，交與伶長。 惡人的罪過在他心裏說： 我眼中不怕上帝！
verses.en: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.zh: 他自誇自媚， 以為他的罪孽終不顯露，不被恨惡。
verses.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

verses.zh: 他口中的言語盡是罪孽詭詐； 他與智慧善行已經斷絕。
verses.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

verses.zh: 他在床上圖謀罪孽， 定意行不善的道，不憎惡惡事。
verses.en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛上及諸天； 你的信實達到穹蒼。
verses.en: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.zh: 你的公義好像高山； 你的判斷如同深淵。 耶和華啊，人民、牲畜，你都救護。
verses.en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你的慈愛何其寶貴！ 世人投靠在你翅膀的蔭下。
verses.en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

verses.zh: 他們必因你殿裏的肥甘得以飽足； 你也必叫他們喝你樂河的[水]。
verses.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

verses.zh: 因為，在你那裏有生命的源頭； 在你的光中，我們必得見光。
verses.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

verses.zh: 願你常施慈愛給認識你的人， 常以公義待心裏正直的人。
verses.en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.zh: 不容驕傲人的腳踐踏我； 不容凶惡人的手趕逐我。
verses.en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

verses.zh: 在那裏，作孽的人已經仆倒； 他們被推倒，不能再起來。
verses.en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 不要為作惡的心懷不平， 也不要向那行不義的生出嫉妒。
verses.en: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.zh: 因為他們如草快被割下， 又如青菜快要枯乾。
verses.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

verses.zh: 你當倚靠耶和華而行善， 住在地上，以他的信實為糧；
verses.en: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

verses.zh: 又要以耶和華為樂， 他就將你心裏所求的賜給你。
verses.en: Delight thyself also in the Lord: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

verses.zh: 當將你的事交託耶和華， 並倚靠他，他就必成全。
verses.en: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

verses.zh: 他要使你的公義如光發出， 使你的公平明如正午。
verses.en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

verses.zh: 你當默然倚靠耶和華，耐性等候他； 不要因那道路通達的和那惡謀成就的心懷不平。
verses.en: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

verses.zh: 當止住怒氣，離棄忿怒； 不要心懷不平，以致作惡。
verses.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

verses.zh: 因為作惡的必被剪除； 惟有等候耶和華的必承受地土。
verses.en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

verses.zh: 還有片時，惡人要歸於無有； 你就是細察他的住處也要歸於無有。
verses.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

verses.zh: 但謙卑人必承受地土， 以豐盛的平安為樂。
verses.en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.zh: 惡人設謀害義人， 又向他咬牙。
verses.en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

verses.zh: 主要笑他， 因見他[受罰]的日子將要來到。
verses.en: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

verses.zh: 惡人已經弓上弦，刀出鞘， 要打倒困苦窮乏的人， 要殺害行動正直的人。
verses.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

verses.zh: 他們的刀必刺入自己的心； 他們的弓必被折斷。
verses.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.zh: 一個義人所有的雖少， 強過許多惡人的富餘。
verses.en: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

verses.zh: 因為惡人的膀臂必被折斷； 但耶和華是扶持義人。
verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

verses.zh: 耶和華知道完全人的日子； 他們的產業要存到永遠。
verses.en: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.zh: 他們在急難的時候不致羞愧， 在饑荒的日子必得飽足。
verses.en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.zh: 惡人卻要滅亡。 耶和華的仇敵要像羊羔的脂油； 他們要消滅，要如煙消滅。
verses.en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

verses.zh: 惡人借貸而不償還； 義人卻恩待人，並且施捨。
verses.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

verses.zh: 蒙耶和華賜福的必承受地土； 被他咒詛的必被剪除。
verses.en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.zh: 義人的腳步被耶和華立定； 他的道路，耶和華也喜愛。
