verses.en: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.

verses.zh: 他雖失腳也不致全身仆倒， 因為耶和華用手攙扶他。
verses.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.

verses.zh: 我從前年幼，現在年老， 卻未見過義人被棄， 也未見過他的後裔討飯。
verses.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.zh: 他終日恩待人，借給人； 他的後裔也蒙福！
verses.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

verses.zh: 你當離惡行善， 就可永遠[安]居。
verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.zh: 因為，耶和華喜愛公平， 不撇棄他的聖民； 他們永蒙保佑， 但惡人的後裔必被剪除。
verses.en: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.zh: 義人必承受地土， 永居其上。
verses.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.zh: 義人的口談論智慧； 他的舌頭講說公平。
verses.en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

verses.zh: 上帝的律法在他心裏； 他的腳總不滑跌。
verses.en: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

verses.zh: 惡人窺探義人， 想要殺他。
verses.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

verses.zh: 耶和華必不撇他在惡人手中； 當審判的時候，也不定他的罪。
verses.en: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.zh: 你當等候耶和華，遵守他的道， 他就抬舉你，使你承受地土； 惡人被剪除的時候，你必看見。
verses.en: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

verses.zh: 我見過惡人大有勢力， 好像一棵青翠樹在本土生發。
verses.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

verses.zh: 有人從那裏經過，不料，他沒有了； 我也尋找他，卻尋不着。
verses.en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.zh: 你要細察那完全人，觀看那正直人， 因為和平人有[好]結局。
verses.en: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

verses.zh: 至於犯法的人，必一同滅絕； 惡人終必剪除。
verses.en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.zh: 但義人得救是由於耶和華； 他在患難時作他們的營寨。
verses.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.zh: 耶和華幫助他們，解救他們； 他解救他們脫離惡人，把他們救出來， 因為他們投靠他。
verses.en: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.zh: 大衛的紀念詩。 耶和華啊，求你不要在怒中責備我， 不要在烈怒中懲罰我！
verses.en: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.zh: 因為，你的箭射入我身； 你的手壓住我。
verses.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

verses.zh: 因你的惱怒，我的肉無一完全； 因我的罪過，我的骨頭也不安寧。
verses.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.zh: 我的罪孽高過我的頭， 如同重擔叫我擔當不起。
verses.en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.zh: 因我的愚昧， 我的傷發臭流膿。
verses.en: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

verses.zh: 我疼痛，大大拳曲， 終日哀痛。
verses.en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

verses.zh: 我滿腰是火； 我的肉無一完全。
verses.en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.zh: 我被壓傷，身體疲倦； 因心裏不安，我就唉哼。
verses.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.zh: 主啊，我的心願都在你面前； 我的歎息不向你隱瞞。
verses.en: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.zh: 我心跳動，我力衰微， 連我眼中的光也沒有了。
verses.en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.zh: 我的良朋密友因我的災病都躲在旁邊站着； 我的親戚本家也遠遠地站立。
verses.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.zh: 那尋索我命的設下網羅； 那想要害我的口出惡言， 終日思想詭計。
verses.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

verses.zh: 但我如聾子不聽， 像啞巴不開口。
verses.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

verses.zh: 我如不聽見的人， 口中沒有回話。
verses.en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我仰望你！ 主－我的上帝啊，你必應允我！
verses.en: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

verses.zh: 我曾說：恐怕他們向我誇耀； 我失腳的時候，他們向我誇大。
verses.en: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

verses.zh: 我幾乎跌倒； 我的痛苦常在我面前。
verses.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.zh: 我要承認我的罪孽； 我要因我的罪憂愁。
verses.en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.zh: 但我的仇敵又活潑又強壯， 無理恨我的增多了。
verses.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.zh: 以惡報善的與我作對， 因我是追求良善。
verses.en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要撇棄我！ 我的上帝啊，求你不要遠離我！
verses.en: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.

verses.zh: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快幫助我！
verses.en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長耶杜頓。 我曾說：我要謹慎我的言行， 免得我舌頭犯罪； 惡人在我面前的時候， 我要用嚼環勒住我的口。
verses.en: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

verses.zh: 我默然無聲，連好話也不出口； 我的愁苦就發動了，
verses.en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

verses.zh: 我的心在我裏面發熱。 我默想的時候，火就燒起， 我便用舌頭說話。
verses.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你叫我曉得我身之終！ 我的壽數幾何？ 叫我知道我的生命不長！
verses.en: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.

verses.zh: 你使我的年日窄如手掌； 我一生的年數，在你面前如同無有。 各人最穩妥的時候，真是全然虛幻。 （細拉）
verses.en: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

verses.zh: 世人行動實係幻影。 他們忙亂，真是枉然； 積蓄[財寶]，不知將來有誰收取。
verses.en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

verses.zh: 主啊，如今我等甚麼呢？ 我的指望在乎你！
verses.en: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

verses.zh: 求你救我脫離一切的過犯， 不要使我受愚頑人的羞辱。
verses.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.zh: 因我所遭遇的是出於你， 我就默然不語。
verses.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

verses.zh: 求你把你的責罰從我身上免去； 因你手的責打，我便消滅。
verses.en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

verses.zh: 你因人的罪惡懲罰他的時候， 叫他的笑容消滅，如[衣]被蟲所咬。 世人真是虛幻！ （細拉）
verses.en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你聽我的禱告， 留心聽我的呼求！ 我流淚，求你不要靜默無聲！ 因為我在你面前是客旅， 是寄居的，像我列祖一般。
verses.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

verses.zh: 求你寬容我， 使我在去而不返之先可以力量復原。
verses.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 我曾耐性等候耶和華； 他垂聽我的呼求。
verses.en: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

verses.zh: 他從禍坑裏， 從淤泥中，把我拉上來， 使我的腳立在磐石上， 使我腳步穩當。
verses.en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

verses.zh: 他使我口唱新歌， 就是讚美我們上帝的話。 許多人必看見而懼怕， 並要倚靠耶和華。
verses.en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

verses.zh: 那倚靠耶和華、 不理會狂傲和偏向虛假之輩的， 這人便為有福！
verses.en: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，你所行的奇事， 並你向我們所懷的意念甚多，不能向你陳明； 若要陳明，其事不可勝數。
verses.en: Many, O Lord my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

verses.zh: 祭物和禮物，你不喜悅； 你已經開通我的耳朵。 燔祭和贖罪祭非你所要。
verses.en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

verses.zh: 那時我說：看哪，我來了！ 我的事在經卷上已經記載了。
verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

verses.zh: 我的上帝啊，我樂意照你的旨意行； 你的律法在我心裏。
verses.en: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

verses.zh: 我在大會中宣傳公義的佳音； 我必不止住我的嘴唇。 耶和華啊，這是你所知道的。
verses.en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.

verses.zh: 我未曾把你的公義藏在心裏； 我已陳明你的信實和你的救恩； 我在大會中未曾隱瞞你的慈愛和誠實。
verses.en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！ 願你的慈愛和誠實常常保佑我！
verses.en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.zh: 因有無數的禍患圍困我， 我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首； 這罪孽比我的頭髮還多， 我就心寒膽戰。
verses.en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你開恩搭救我！ 耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
verses.en: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.

verses.zh: 願那些尋找我、要滅我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！ 願那些喜悅我受害的，退後受辱！
verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.zh: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧而敗亡！
verses.en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.zh: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜！ 願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊耶和華為大！
verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

verses.zh: 但我是困苦窮乏的，主仍顧念我； 你是幫助我的，搭救我的。 上帝啊，求你不要耽延！
verses.en: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 眷顧貧窮的有福了！ 他遭難的日子，耶和華必搭救他。
verses.en: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.

verses.zh: 耶和華必保全他，使他存活； 他必在地上享福。 求你不要把他交給仇敵，遂其所願。
verses.en: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

verses.zh: 他病重在榻，耶和華必扶持他； 他在病中，你必給他鋪床。
verses.en: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

verses.zh: 我曾說：耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，醫治我！ 因為我得罪了你。
verses.en: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

verses.zh: 我的仇敵用惡言議論我[說]： 他幾時死，他的名才滅亡呢？
verses.en: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.zh: 他來看[我]就說假話； 他心存奸惡，走到外邊才說出來。
verses.en: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

verses.zh: 一切恨我的，都交頭接耳地議論我； 他們設計要害我。
verses.en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

verses.zh: [他們說]：有怪病貼在他身上； 他已躺臥，必不能再起來。
verses.en: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

verses.zh: 連我知己的朋友， 我所倚靠、吃過我飯的也用腳踢我。
verses.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我， 使我起來，好報復他們！
verses.en: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

verses.zh: 因我的仇敵不得向我誇勝， 我從此便知道你喜愛我。
verses.en: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

verses.zh: 你因我純正就扶持我， 使我永遠站在你的面前。
verses.en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

verses.zh: 耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的， 從亙古直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

verses.zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。 上帝啊，我的心切慕你， 如鹿切慕溪水。
verses.en: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

verses.zh: 我的心渴想上帝，就是永生上帝； 我幾時得朝見上帝呢？
verses.en: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.zh: 我晝夜以眼淚當飲食； 人不住地對我說：你的上帝在哪裏呢？
verses.en: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.zh: 我從前與眾人同往， 用歡呼稱讚的聲音 領他們到上帝的殿裏，大家守節。 我追想這些事， 我的心極其悲傷。
verses.en: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

verses.zh: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ 為何在我裏面煩躁？ 應當仰望上帝，因他笑臉幫助我； 我還要稱讚他。
verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

verses.zh: 我的上帝啊，我的心在我裏面憂悶， 所以我從約旦地， 從黑門嶺，從米薩山記念你。
verses.en: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

verses.zh: 你的瀑布發聲，深淵就與深淵響應； 你的波浪洪濤漫過我身。
verses.en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

verses.zh: 白晝，耶和華必向我施慈愛； 黑夜，我要歌頌禱告賜我生命的上帝。
verses.en: Yet the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

verses.zh: 我要對上帝－我的磐石說： 你為何忘記我呢？ 我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
verses.en: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.zh: 我的敵人辱罵我， 好像打碎我的骨頭， 不住地對我說： 你的上帝在哪裏呢？
verses.en: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.zh: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ 為何在我裏面煩躁？ 應當仰望上帝，因我還要稱讚他。 他是我臉上的光榮，是我的上帝。
verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，求你伸我的冤， 向不虔誠的國為我辨屈； 求你救我脫離詭詐不義的人。
verses.en: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.zh: 因為你是賜我力量的上帝，為何丟棄我呢？ 我為何因仇敵的欺壓時常哀痛呢？
verses.en: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.zh: 求你發出你的亮光和真實，好引導我， 帶我到你的聖山，到你的居所！
verses.en: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

verses.zh: 我就走到上帝的祭壇， 到我最喜樂的上帝那裏。 上帝啊，我的上帝， 我要彈琴稱讚你！
verses.en: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

verses.zh: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ 為何在我裏面煩躁？ 應當仰望上帝，因我還要稱讚他。 他是我臉上的光榮，是我的上帝。
verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，交與伶長。 上帝啊，你在古時， 我們列祖的日子所行的事， 我們親耳聽見了； 我們的列祖也給我們述說過。
verses.en: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

verses.zh: 你曾用手趕出外邦人， 卻栽培了我們列祖； 你苦待列邦， 卻叫我們列祖發達。
verses.en: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

verses.zh: 因為他們不是靠自己的刀劍得地土， 也不是靠自己的膀臂得勝， 乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂， 和你臉上的亮光， 因為你喜悅他們。
verses.en: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你是我的王； 求你出令使雅各得勝。
verses.en: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.zh: 我們靠你要推倒我們的敵人， 靠你的名要踐踏那起來攻擊我們的人。
verses.en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.zh: 因為，我必不靠我的弓； 我的刀也不能使我得勝。
verses.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.zh: 惟你救了我們脫離敵人， 使恨我們的人羞愧。
verses.en: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

verses.zh: 我們終日因上帝誇耀， 還要永遠稱謝你的名。 （細拉）
verses.en: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

verses.zh: 但如今你丟棄了我們，使我們受辱， 不和我們的軍兵同去。
verses.en: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

verses.zh: 你使我們向敵人轉身退後； 那恨我們的人任意搶奪。
verses.en: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

verses.zh: 你使我們當作快要被吃的羊， 把我們分散在列邦中。
verses.en: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

verses.zh: 你賣了你的子民也不賺利， 所得的價值並不加添你的[資財]。
verses.en: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

verses.zh: 你使我們受鄰國的羞辱， 被四圍的人嗤笑譏刺。
verses.en: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.zh: 你使我們在列邦中作了笑談， 使眾民向我們搖頭。
verses.en: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.zh: 我的凌辱終日在我面前， 我臉上的羞愧將我遮蔽，
verses.en: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

verses.zh: 都因那辱罵毀謗人的聲音， 又因仇敵和報仇人的緣故。
verses.en: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.zh: 這都臨到我們身上， 我們卻沒有忘記你， 也沒有違背你的約。
verses.en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

verses.zh: 我們的心沒有退後； 我們的腳也沒有偏離你的路。
verses.en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

verses.zh: 你在野狗之處壓傷我們， 用死蔭遮蔽我們。
verses.en: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.zh: 倘若我們忘了上帝的名， 或向別神舉手，
verses.en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.zh: 上帝豈不鑒察這事嗎？ 因為他曉得人心裏的隱秘。
verses.en: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

verses.zh: 我們為你的緣故終日被殺； 人看我們如將宰的羊。
verses.en: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.zh: 主啊，求你睡醒，為何儘睡呢？ 求你興起，不要永遠丟棄[我們]！
verses.en: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

verses.zh: 你為何掩面， 不顧我們所遭的苦難和所受的欺壓？
verses.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.zh: 我們的性命伏於塵土； 我們的肚腹緊貼地面。
verses.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

verses.zh: 求你起來幫助我們！ 憑你的慈愛救贖我們！
verses.en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

verses.zh: 可拉後裔的訓誨詩，又是愛慕歌，交與伶長。調用百合花。 我心裏湧出美辭； 我論到我為王做的事， 我的舌頭是快手筆。
verses.en: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.zh: 你比世人更美； 在你嘴裏滿有恩惠； 所以上帝賜福給你，直到永遠。
verses.en: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.zh: 大能者啊，願你腰間佩刀， 大有榮耀和威嚴！
verses.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.zh: 為真理、謙卑、公義赫然坐車前往，無不得勝； 你的右手必顯明可畏的事。
verses.en: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

verses.zh: 你的箭鋒快，射中王敵之心； 萬民仆倒在你以下。
verses.en: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的； 你的國權是正直的。
verses.en: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

verses.zh: 你喜愛公義，恨惡罪惡； 所以上帝－就是你的上帝－用喜樂油膏你， 勝過膏你的同伴。
verses.en: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.zh: 你的衣服都有沒藥、沉香、肉桂[的香氣]； 象牙宮中有絲弦樂器的聲音使你歡喜。
verses.en: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

verses.zh: 有君王的女兒在你尊貴婦女之中； 王后佩戴俄斐金飾站在你右邊。
verses.en: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.zh: 女子啊，你要聽，要想，要側耳而聽！ 不要記念你的民和你的父家，
verses.en: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

verses.zh: 王就羨慕你的美貌； 因為他是你的主，你當敬拜他。
verses.en: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

verses.zh: 泰爾的民[必來]送禮； 民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
verses.en: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

verses.zh: 王女在[宮]裏極其榮華； 她的衣服是用金[線]繡的。
verses.en: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

verses.zh: 她要穿錦繡的衣服，被引到王前； 隨從她的陪伴童女也要被帶到你面前。
verses.en: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

verses.zh: 她們要歡喜快樂被引導； 她們要進入王宮。
verses.en: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.

verses.zh: 你的子孫要接續你的列祖； 你要立他們在全地作王。
verses.en: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

verses.zh: 我必叫你的名被萬代記念， 所以萬民要永永遠遠稱謝你。
verses.en: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

verses.zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌，交與伶長。調用女音。 上帝是我們的避難所，是我們的力量， 是[我們]在患難中隨時的幫助。
verses.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.zh: 所以，地雖改變， 山雖搖動到海心，
verses.en: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

verses.zh: 其中的水雖匉訇翻騰， 山雖因海漲而戰抖， 我們也不害怕。 （細拉）
verses.en: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

verses.zh: 有一道河，這河的分汊使上帝的城歡喜； 這城就是至高者居住的聖所。
verses.en: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

verses.zh: 上帝在其中，城必不動搖； 到天一亮，上帝必幫助這城。
verses.en: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

verses.zh: 外邦喧嚷，列國動搖； 上帝發聲，地便鎔化。
verses.en: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.zh: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在； 雅各的上帝是我們的避難所！ （細拉）
verses.en: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.zh: 你們來看耶和華的作為， 看他使地怎樣荒涼。
verses.en: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

verses.zh: 他止息刀兵，直到地極； 他折弓、斷槍，把戰車焚燒在火中。
verses.en: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

verses.zh: 你們要休息，要知道我是上帝！ 我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
verses.en: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.zh: 萬軍之耶和華與我們同在； 雅各的上帝是我們的避難所！
verses.en: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.zh: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。 萬民哪，你們都要拍掌！ 要用誇勝的聲音向上帝呼喊！
verses.en: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

verses.zh: 因為耶和華至高者是可畏的； 他是治理全地的大君王。
verses.en: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

verses.zh: 他叫萬民服在我們以下， 又叫列邦服在我們腳下。
verses.en: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.zh: 他為我們選擇產業， 就是他所愛之雅各的榮耀。 （細拉）
verses.en: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

verses.zh: 上帝上升，有喊聲相送； 耶和華上升，有角聲相送。
verses.en: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.zh: 你們要向上帝歌頌，歌頌！ 向我們王歌頌，歌頌！
verses.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

verses.zh: 因為上帝是全地的王； 你們要用悟性歌頌。
verses.en: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

verses.zh: 上帝作王治理萬國； 上帝坐在他的聖寶座上。
verses.en: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

verses.zh: 列邦的君王聚集要作亞伯拉罕之上帝的民。 因為世界的盾牌是屬上帝的； 他為至高！
verses.en: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

verses.zh: 可拉後裔的詩歌。 耶和華本為大！ 在我們上帝的城中， 在他的聖山上，該受大讚美。
verses.en: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

verses.zh: 錫安山－大君王的城， 在北面居高華美， 為全地所喜悅。
verses.en: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.zh: 上帝在其宮中， 自顯為避難所。
verses.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.zh: 看哪，眾王會合， 一同經過。
verses.en: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

verses.zh: 他們見了這城就驚奇喪膽， 急忙逃跑。
verses.en: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

verses.zh: 他們在那裏被戰兢疼痛抓住， 好像產難的婦人一樣。
verses.en: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.zh: [上帝啊]，你用東風打破他施的船隻。
verses.en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.zh: 我們在萬軍之耶和華的城中 －就是我們上帝的城中－所看見的， 正如我們所聽見的。 上帝必堅立這城，直到永遠。 （細拉）
verses.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，我們在你的殿中想念你的慈愛。
verses.en: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你受的讚美正與你的名相稱，直到地極！ 你的右手滿了公義。
verses.en: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.zh: 因你的判斷，錫安山應當歡喜， 猶大的城邑應當快樂。
verses.en: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

verses.zh: 你們當周遊錫安， 四圍旋繞，數點城樓，
verses.en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

verses.zh: 細看她的外郭， 察看她的宮殿， 為要傳說到後代。
verses.en: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

verses.zh: 因為這上帝永永遠遠為我們的上帝； 他必作我們引路的，直到死時。
verses.en: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

verses.zh: 可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。 萬民哪，你們都當聽這話！ 世上一切的居民，
verses.en: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

verses.zh: 無論上流下流，富足貧窮， 都當留心聽！
verses.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

verses.zh: 我口要說智慧的言語； 我心要想通達的道理。
verses.en: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

verses.zh: 我要側耳聽比喻， 用琴解謎語。
verses.en: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

verses.zh: 在患難的日子，奸惡隨我腳跟，四面環繞我， 我何必懼怕？
verses.en: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

verses.zh: 那些倚仗財貨自誇錢財多的人，
verses.en: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.zh: 一個也無法贖自己的弟兄， 也不能替他將贖價給上帝，
verses.en: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

verses.zh: 叫他長遠活着，不見朽壞； 因為贖他生命的價值極貴， 只可永遠罷休。
verses.en: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

verses.zh: 他必見智慧人死， 又見愚頑人和畜類人一同滅亡， 將他們的財貨留給別人。
verses.en: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.zh: 他們心裏思想： 他們的家室必永存， 住宅必留到萬代； 他們以自己的名稱自己的地。
verses.en: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

verses.zh: 但人居尊貴中不能長久， 如同死亡的畜類一樣。
verses.en: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.zh: 他們行的這道本為自己的愚昧； 但他們以後的人還佩服他們的話語。 （細拉）
verses.en: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.zh: 他們如同羊群派定下陰間； 死亡必作他們的牧者。 到了早晨，正直人必管轄他們； 他們的美容必被陰間所滅，以致無處可存。
verses.en: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

verses.zh: 只是上帝必救贖我的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄， 因他必收納我。 （細拉）
verses.en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

verses.zh: 見人發財、家室增榮的時候， 你不要懼怕；
verses.en: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.zh: 因為，他死的時候甚麼也不能帶去； 他的榮耀不能隨他下去。
verses.en: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

verses.zh: 他活着的時候，雖然自誇為有福 （你若利己，人必誇獎你）；
verses.en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

verses.zh: 他仍必歸到他歷代的祖宗那裏， 永不見光。
verses.en: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

verses.zh: 人在尊貴中而不醒悟， 就如死亡的畜類一樣。
verses.en: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

verses.zh: 亞薩的詩。 大能者上帝－耶和華已經發言招呼天下， 從日出之地到日落之處。
verses.en: The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

verses.zh: 從全美的錫安中， 上帝已經發光了。
verses.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

verses.zh: 我們的上帝要來，決不閉口。 有烈火在他面前吞滅； 有暴風在他四圍大颳。
verses.en: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

verses.zh: 他招呼上天下地， 為要審判他的民，
verses.en: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

verses.zh: 說：招聚我的聖民到我這裏來， 就是那些用祭物與我立約的人。
verses.en: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

verses.zh: 諸天必表明他的公義， 因為上帝是施行審判的。 （細拉）
verses.en: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

verses.zh: 我的民哪，你們當聽我的話！ 以色列啊，我要勸戒你； 我是上帝，是你的上帝！
verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

verses.zh: 我並不因你的祭物責備你； 你的燔祭常在我面前。
verses.en: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

verses.zh: 我不從你家中取公牛， 也不從你圈內取山羊；
verses.en: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

verses.zh: 因為，樹林中的百獸是我的， 千山上的牲畜也是我的。
verses.en: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.zh: 山中的飛鳥，我都知道； 野地的走獸也都屬我。
verses.en: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

verses.zh: 我若是飢餓，我不用告訴你， 因為世界和其中所充滿的都是我的。
verses.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.zh: 我豈吃公牛的肉呢？ 我豈喝山羊的血呢？
verses.en: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.zh: 你們要以感謝為祭獻與上帝， 又要向至高者還你的願，
verses.en: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

verses.zh: 並要在患難之日求告我； 我必搭救你，你也要榮耀我。
verses.en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

verses.zh: 但上帝對惡人說：你怎敢傳說我的律例， 口中提到我的約呢？
verses.en: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

verses.zh: 其實你恨惡管教， 將我的言語丟在背後。
verses.en: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and casteth my words behind thee.

verses.zh: 你見了盜賊就樂意與他同夥， 又與行姦淫的人一同有分。
verses.en: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

verses.zh: 你口任說惡言； 你舌編造詭詐。
verses.en: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

verses.zh: 你坐着毀謗你的兄弟， 讒毀你親母的兒子。
verses.en: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

verses.zh: 你行了這些事，我還閉口不言， 你想我恰和你一樣； 其實我要責備你，將這些事擺在你眼前。
verses.en: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

verses.zh: 你們忘記上帝的，要思想這事， 免得我把你們撕碎，無人搭救。
verses.en: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

verses.zh: 凡以感謝獻上為祭的便是榮耀我； 那按正路而行的，我必使他得着我的救恩。
verses.en: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

verses.zh: 大衛與拔示巴同室以後，先知拿單來見他；他作這詩，交與伶長。 上帝啊，求你按你的慈愛憐恤我！ 按你豐盛的慈悲塗抹我的過犯！
verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.zh: 求你將我的罪孽洗除淨盡， 並潔除我的罪！
verses.en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.zh: 因為，我知道我的過犯； 我的罪常在我面前。
verses.en: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

verses.zh: 我向你犯罪，惟獨得罪了你； 在你眼前行了這惡， 以致你責備我的時候顯為公義， 判斷我的時候顯為清正。
verses.en: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

verses.zh: 我是在罪孽裏生的， 在我母親懷胎的時候就有了罪。
verses.en: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.zh: 你所喜愛的是內裏誠實； 你在我隱密處，必使我得智慧。
verses.en: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

verses.zh: 求你用牛膝草潔淨我，我就乾淨； 求你洗滌我，我就比雪更白。
verses.en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.zh: 求你使我得聽歡喜快樂[的聲音]， 使你所壓傷的骨頭可以踴躍。
verses.en: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

verses.zh: 求你掩面不看我的罪， 塗抹我一切的罪孽。
verses.en: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，求你為我造清潔的心， 使我裏面重新有正直的靈。
verses.en: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.zh: 不要丟棄我，使我離開你的面； 不要從我收回你的聖靈。
verses.en: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

verses.zh: 求你使我仍得救恩之樂， 賜我樂意的靈扶持我，
verses.en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

verses.zh: 我就把你的道指教有過犯的人， 罪人必歸順你。
verses.en: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你是拯救我的上帝； 求你救我脫離流人血的罪！ 我的舌頭就高聲歌唱你的公義。
verses.en: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

verses.zh: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇張開， 我的口便傳揚讚美你的話！
verses.en: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

verses.zh: 你本不喜愛祭物，若喜愛，我就獻上； 燔祭，你也不喜悅。
verses.en: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

verses.zh: [上帝所要]的祭就是憂傷的靈； 上帝啊，憂傷痛悔的心，你必不輕看。
verses.en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

verses.zh: 求你隨你的美意善待錫安， 建造耶路撒冷的城牆。
verses.en: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.zh: 那時，你必喜愛公義的祭 和燔祭並全牲的燔祭； 那時，人必將公牛獻在你壇上。
verses.en: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

verses.zh: 以東人多益來告訴掃羅說：「大衛到了亞希米勒家。」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。 勇士啊，你為何以作惡自誇？ 上帝的慈愛是常存的。
verses.en: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

verses.zh: 你的舌頭邪惡詭詐， 好像剃頭刀，快利傷人。
verses.en: The tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.zh: 你愛惡勝似愛善， 又愛說謊，不愛說公義。 （細拉）
verses.en: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

verses.zh: 詭詐的舌頭啊， 你愛說一切毀滅的話！
verses.en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

verses.zh: 上帝也要毀滅你，直到永遠； 他要把你拿去，從你的帳棚中抽出， 從活人之地將你拔出。 （細拉）
verses.en: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

verses.zh: 義人要看見而懼怕， 並要笑他，
verses.en: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

verses.zh: 說：看哪，這就是那不以上帝為他力量的人， 只倚仗他豐富的財物，在邪惡上堅立自己。
verses.en: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.zh: 至於我，就像上帝殿中的青橄欖樹； 我永永遠遠倚靠上帝的慈愛。
verses.en: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

verses.zh: 我要稱謝你，直到永遠， 因為你行了這事。 我也要在你聖民面前仰望你的名； 這名本為美好。
verses.en: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

verses.zh: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。調用麻哈拉。 愚頑人心裏說：沒有上帝。 他們都是邪惡，行了可憎惡的罪孽； 沒有一個人行善。
verses.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

verses.zh: 上帝從天上垂看世人，要看有明白的沒有？ 有尋求他的沒有？
verses.en: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

verses.zh: 他們各人都退後，一同變為污穢； 並沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
verses.en: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.zh: 作孽的沒有知識嗎？ 他們吞吃我的百姓如同吃飯一樣，並不求告上帝。
verses.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

verses.zh: 他們在無可懼怕之處就大大害怕， 因為上帝把那安營攻擊你之人的骨頭散開了。 你使他們蒙羞，因為上帝棄絕了他們。
verses.en: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

verses.zh: 但願以色列的救恩從錫安而出。 上帝救回他被擄的子民那時， 雅各要快樂，以色列要歡喜。
verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.zh: 西弗人來對掃羅說：「大衛豈不是在我們那裏藏身嗎？」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 上帝啊，求你以你的名救我， 憑你的大能為我伸冤。
verses.en: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，求你聽我的禱告， 留心聽我口中的言語。
verses.en: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.zh: 因為，外人起來攻擊我， 強暴人尋索我的命； 他們眼中沒有上帝。 （細拉）
verses.en: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

verses.zh: 上帝是幫助我的，是扶持我命的。
verses.en: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

verses.zh: 他要報應我仇敵所行的惡； 求你憑你的誠實滅絕他們。
verses.en: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

verses.zh: 我要把甘心祭獻給你。 耶和華啊，我要稱讚你的名；這名本為美好。
verses.en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

verses.zh: 他從一切的急難中把我救出來； 我的眼睛也看見了我仇敵[遭報]。
verses.en: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

verses.zh: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 上帝啊，求你留心聽我的禱告， 不要隱藏不聽我的懇求！
verses.en: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.zh: 求你側耳聽我，應允我。 我哀歎不安，發聲唉哼，
verses.en: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.zh: 都因仇敵的聲音，惡人的欺壓； 因為他們將罪孽加在我身上，發怒氣逼迫我。
verses.en: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.zh: 我心在我裏面甚是疼痛； 死的驚惶臨到我身。
verses.en: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.zh: 恐懼戰兢歸到我身； 驚恐漫過了我。
verses.en: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.zh: 我說：但願我有翅膀像鴿子， 我就飛去，得享安息。
verses.en: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.zh: 我必遠遊， 宿在曠野。 （細拉）
verses.en: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.zh: 我必速速逃到避所， 脫離狂風暴雨。
verses.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

verses.zh: 主啊，求你吞滅他們，變亂他們的舌頭！ 因為我在城中見了強暴爭競的事。
verses.en: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.zh: 他們在城牆上晝夜繞行； 在城內也有罪孽和奸惡。
verses.en: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

verses.zh: 邪惡在其中； 欺壓和詭詐不離街市。
verses.en: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.zh: 原來不是仇敵辱罵我， 若是仇敵，還可忍耐； 也不是恨我的人向我狂大， 若是恨我的人就必躲避他。
verses.en: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.zh: 不料是你；你原與我平等， 是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！
verses.en: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

verses.zh: 我們素常彼此談論，以為甘甜； 我們與群眾在上帝的殿中同行。
verses.en: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

verses.zh: 願死亡忽然臨到他們！ 願他們活活地下入陰間！ 因為他們的住處，他們的心中，都是邪惡。
verses.en: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.zh: 至於我，我要求告上帝； 耶和華必拯救我。
verses.en: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

verses.zh: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀聲悲歎； 他也必聽我的聲音。
verses.en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.zh: 他救贖我命脫離攻擊我的人， 使我得享平安， 因為與我[相爭的]人甚多。
verses.en: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

verses.zh: 那沒有更變、不敬畏上帝的人， 從太古常存的上帝必聽見而苦待他。
verses.en: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

verses.zh: 他背了約， 伸手攻擊與他和好的人。
verses.en: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

verses.zh: 他的口如奶油光滑， 他的心卻懷着爭戰； 他的話比油柔和， 其實是拔出來的刀。
verses.en: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

verses.zh: 你要把你的重擔卸給耶和華， 他必撫養你； 他永不叫義人動搖。
verses.en: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你必使惡人下入滅亡的坑； 流人血、行詭詐的人必活不到半世， 但我要倚靠你。
verses.en: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

verses.zh: 非利士人在迦特拿住大衛。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用遠方無聲鴿。 上帝啊，求你憐憫我，因為人要把我吞了， 終日攻擊欺壓我。
verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

verses.zh: 我的仇敵終日要把我吞了， 因逞驕傲攻擊我的人甚多。
verses.en: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

verses.zh: 我懼怕的時候要倚靠你。
verses.en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

verses.zh: 我倚靠上帝，我要讚美他的話； 我倚靠上帝，必不懼怕。 血氣之輩能把我怎麼樣呢？
verses.en: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

verses.zh: 他們終日顛倒我的話； 他們一切的心思都是要害我。
verses.en: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.zh: 他們聚集，埋伏窺探我的腳蹤， 等候要害我的命。
verses.en: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

verses.zh: 他們豈能因罪孽逃脫嗎？ 上帝啊，求你在怒中使眾民墮落！
verses.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

verses.zh: 我幾次流離，你都記數； 求你把我眼淚裝在你的皮袋裏。 這不都記在你冊子上嗎？
verses.en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

verses.zh: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敵都要轉身退後。 上帝幫助我，這是我所知道的。
verses.en: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

verses.zh: 我倚靠上帝，我要讚美他的話； 我倚靠耶和華，我要讚美他的話。
verses.en: In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.

verses.zh: 我倚靠上帝，必不懼怕。 人能把我怎麼樣呢？
verses.en: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，我向你所許的願在我身上； 我要將感謝祭獻給你。
verses.en: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

verses.zh: 因為你救我的命脫離死亡。 你豈不是[救護]我的腳不跌倒、 使我在生命光中行在上帝面前嗎？
verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

verses.zh: 大衛逃避掃羅，藏在洞裏。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。 上帝啊，求你憐憫我，憐憫我！ 因為我的心投靠你。 我要投靠在你翅膀的蔭下， 等到災害過去。
verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

verses.zh: 我要求告至高的上帝， 就是為我成全[諸事]的上帝。
verses.en: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

verses.zh: 那要吞我的人辱罵我的時候， 上帝從天上必施恩救我， 也必向我發出慈愛和誠實。
verses.en: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

verses.zh: 我的性命在獅子中間； 我躺臥在性如烈火的世人當中。 他們的牙齒是槍、箭； 他們的舌頭是快刀。
verses.en: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！ 願你的榮耀高過全地！
verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.zh: 他們為我的腳設下網羅，壓制我的心； 他們在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。 （細拉）
verses.en: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，我心堅定，我心堅定； 我要唱詩，我要歌頌！
verses.en: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

verses.zh: 我的靈啊，你當醒起！ 琴瑟啊，你們當醒起！ 我自己要極早醒起！
verses.en: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.zh: 主啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你， 在列邦中歌頌你！
verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.zh: 因為，你的慈愛高及諸天； 你的誠實達到穹蒼。
verses.en: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！ 願你的榮耀高過全地！
verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.zh: 大衛的金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。 世人哪，你們默然不語，真合公義嗎？ 施行審判，豈按正直嗎？
verses.en: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

verses.zh: 不然！你們是心中作惡； 你們在地上秤出你們手所行的強暴。
verses.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.zh: 惡人一出母胎就[與]上帝疏遠， 一離母腹便走錯路，說謊話。
verses.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

verses.zh: 他們的毒氣好像蛇的毒氣； 他們好像塞耳的聾虺，
verses.en: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

verses.zh: 不聽行法術的聲音， 雖用極靈的咒語也是不聽。
verses.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，求你敲碎他們口中的牙！ 耶和華啊，求你敲掉少壯獅子的大牙！
verses.en: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.

verses.zh: 願他們消滅，如急流的水一般； 他們瞅準射箭的時候，願箭頭彷彿砍斷。
verses.en: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.zh: 願他們像蝸牛消化過去， 又像婦人墜落未見天日的胎。
verses.en: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

verses.zh: 你們用荊棘燒火，鍋還未熱， 他要用旋風把青的和燒着的一齊颳去。
verses.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

verses.zh: 義人見[仇敵]遭報就歡喜， 要在惡人的血中洗腳。
verses.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.zh: 因此，人必說：義人誠然有善報； 在地上果有施行判斷的上帝！
verses.en: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

verses.zh: 掃羅打發人窺探大衛的房屋，要殺他。那時，大衛作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。 我的上帝啊，求你救我脫離仇敵， 把我安置在高處，得脫那些起來攻擊我的人。
verses.en: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.zh: 求你救我脫離作孽的人 和喜愛流人血的人！
verses.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.zh: 因為，他們埋伏要害我的命； 有能力的人聚集來攻擊我。 耶和華啊，這不是為我的過犯， 也不是為我的罪愆。
verses.en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.

verses.zh: 我雖然無過，他們預備整齊，跑來攻擊我。 求你興起鑒察，幫助我！
verses.en: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

verses.zh: 萬軍之上帝－耶和華以色列的上帝啊！ 求你興起，懲治萬邦！ 不要憐憫行詭詐的惡人！ （細拉）
verses.en: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.zh: 他們晚上轉回， 叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
verses.en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.zh: 他們口中噴吐[惡言]，嘴裏有刀； [他們說]：有誰聽見？
verses.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

verses.zh: 但你－耶和華必笑話他們； 你要嗤笑萬邦。
verses.en: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

verses.zh: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你， 因為上帝是我的高臺。
verses.en: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

verses.zh: 我的上帝要以慈愛迎接我； 上帝要叫我看見我仇敵[遭報]。
verses.en: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

verses.zh: 不要殺他們，恐怕我的民忘記。 主啊，你是我們的盾牌； 求你用你的能力使他們四散， 且降為卑。
verses.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

verses.zh: 因他們口中的罪和嘴裏的言語， 並咒罵虛謊的話， 願他們在驕傲之中被纏住了。
verses.en: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

verses.zh: 求你發怒，使他們消滅， 以致歸於無有， 叫他們知道上帝在雅各中間掌權， 直到地極。 （細拉）
verses.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.zh: 到了晚上，任憑他們轉回； 任憑他們叫號如狗，圍城繞行。
verses.en: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.zh: 他們必走來走去，尋找食物， 若不得飽就終夜在外。
verses.en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

verses.zh: 但我要歌頌你的力量， 早晨要高唱你的慈愛； 因為你作過我的高臺， 在我急難的日子作過我的避難所。
verses.en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.zh: 我的力量啊，我要歌頌你； 因為上帝是我的高臺， 是賜恩與我的上帝。
verses.en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

verses.zh: 大衛與兩河間的亞蘭並瑣巴的亞蘭爭戰的時候，約押轉回，在鹽谷攻擊以東，殺了一萬二千人。那時，大衛作這金詩，叫人學習，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。 上帝啊，你丟棄了我們，使我們破敗； 你向我們發怒，求你使我們復興！
verses.en: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

verses.zh: 你使地震動，而且崩裂； 求你將裂口醫好，因為地搖動。
verses.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.zh: 你叫你的民遇見艱難； 你叫我們喝那使人東倒西歪的酒。
verses.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.zh: 你把旌旗賜給敬畏你的人， 可以為真理揚起來。 （細拉）
verses.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.zh: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們， 好叫你所親愛的人得救。
verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.zh: 上帝已經指着他的聖潔說：我要歡樂； 我要分開示劍，丈量疏割谷。
verses.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.zh: 基列是我的，瑪拿西也是我的。 以法蓮是護衛我頭的； 猶大是我的杖。
verses.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以東拋鞋。 非利士啊，你還能因我歡呼嗎？
verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

verses.zh: 誰能領我進堅固城？ 誰能引我到以東地？
verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你不是丟棄了我們嗎？ 上帝啊，你不和我們的軍兵同去嗎？
verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

verses.zh: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人， 因為人的幫助是枉然的。
verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.zh: 我們倚靠上帝才得施展大能， 因為踐踏我們敵人的就是他。
verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 上帝啊，求你聽我的呼求， 側耳聽我的禱告！
verses.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.zh: 我心裏發昏的時候， 我要從地極求告你。 求你領我到那比我更高的磐石！
verses.en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.zh: 因為你作過我的避難所， 作過我的堅固臺，脫離仇敵。
verses.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.zh: 我要永遠住在你的帳幕裏！ 我要投靠在你翅膀下的隱密處！ （細拉）
verses.en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你原是聽了我所許的願； 你將產業賜給敬畏你名的人。
verses.en: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.zh: 你要加添王的壽數； 他的年歲必存到世世。
verses.en: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.

verses.zh: 他必永遠坐在上帝面前； 願你預備慈愛和誠實保佑他！
verses.en: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

verses.zh: 這樣，我要歌頌你的名，直到永遠， 好天天還我所許的願。
verses.en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。 我的心默默無聲，專等候上帝； 我的救恩是從他[而來]。
verses.en: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

verses.zh: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高臺，我必不很動搖。
verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.zh: 你們大家攻擊一人，把他毀壞， 如同毀壞歪斜的牆、將倒的壁，要到幾時呢？
verses.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

verses.zh: 他們彼此商議，專要從他的尊位上把他推下； 他們喜愛謊話，口雖祝福，心卻咒詛。 （細拉）
verses.en: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

verses.zh: 我的心哪，你當默默無聲，專等候上帝， 因為我的盼望是從他[而來]。
verses.en: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

verses.zh: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高臺，我必不動搖。
verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.zh: 我的拯救、我的榮耀都在乎上帝； 我力量的磐石、我的避難所都在乎上帝。
verses.en: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.zh: 你們眾民當時時倚靠他， 在他面前傾心吐意； 上帝是我們的避難所。 （細拉）
verses.en: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

verses.zh: 下流人真是虛空； 上流人也是虛假； 放在天平裏就必浮起； 他們一共比空氣還輕。
verses.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

verses.zh: 不要仗勢欺人， 也不要因搶奪而驕傲； 若財寶加增，不要放在心上。
verses.en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

verses.zh: 上帝說了一次、兩次，我都聽見： 就是能力都屬乎上帝。
verses.en: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

verses.zh: 主啊，慈愛也是屬乎你， 因為你照着各人所行的報應他。
verses.en: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

verses.zh: 大衛在猶大曠野的時候，作了這詩。 上帝啊，你是我的上帝， 我要切切地尋求你， 在乾旱疲乏無水之地，我渴想你； 我的心切慕你。
verses.en: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.zh: 我在聖所中曾如此瞻仰你， 為要見你的能力和你的榮耀。
verses.en: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

verses.zh: 因你的慈愛比生命更好， 我的嘴唇要頌讚你。
verses.en: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

verses.zh: 我還活的時候要這樣稱頌你； 我要奉你的名舉手。
verses.en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

verses.zh: 我在床上記念你， 在夜更的時候思想你； 我的心就像飽足了骨髓肥油， 我也要以歡樂的嘴唇讚美你。
verses.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

verses.zh: 因為你曾幫助我， 我就在你翅膀的蔭下歡呼。
verses.en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

verses.zh: 我心緊緊地跟隨你； 你的右手扶持我。
verses.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

verses.zh: 但那些尋索要滅我命的人 必往地底下去；
verses.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.zh: 他們必被刀劍所殺， 被野狗所吃。
verses.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

verses.zh: 但是王必因上帝歡喜。 凡指着他發誓的必要誇口， 因為說謊之人的口必被塞住。
verses.en: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 上帝啊，我哀歎的時候，求你聽我的聲音！ 求你保護我的性命，不受仇敵的驚恐！
verses.en: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.zh: 求你把我隱藏， 使我脫離作惡之人的暗謀和作孽之人的擾亂。
verses.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

verses.zh: 他們磨舌如刀， 發出苦毒的言語，好像比準了的箭，
verses.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

verses.zh: 要在暗地射完全人； 他們忽然射他，並不懼怕。
verses.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.zh: 他們彼此勉勵設下惡計； 他們商量暗設網羅， 說：誰能看見？
verses.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.zh: 他們圖謀奸惡， [說]：我們是極力圖謀的。 他們各人的意念心思是深的。
verses.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

verses.zh: 但上帝要射他們； 他們忽然被箭射傷。
verses.en: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

verses.zh: 他們必然絆跌，被自己的舌頭所害； 凡看見他們的必都搖頭。
verses.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

verses.zh: 眾人都要害怕， 要傳揚上帝的工作， 並且明白他的作為。
verses.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.zh: 義人必因耶和華歡喜， 並要投靠他； 凡心裏正直的人都要誇口。
verses.en: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。 上帝啊，錫安的人都等候讚美你； 所許的願也要向你償還。
verses.en: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.zh: 聽禱告的[主]啊， 凡有血氣的都要來就你。
verses.en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.zh: 罪孽勝了我； 至於我們的過犯，你都要赦免。
verses.en: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

verses.zh: 你所揀選、使他親近你、住在你院中的， 這人便為有福！ 我們必因你居所、你聖殿的美福知足了。
verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

verses.zh: 拯救我們的上帝啊，你必以威嚴秉公義應允我們； 你本是一切地極和海上遠處的人所倚靠的。
verses.en: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

verses.zh: 他既以大能束腰， 就用力量安定諸山，
verses.en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

verses.zh: 使諸海的響聲和其中波浪的響聲， 並萬民的喧嘩，都平靜了。
verses.en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.zh: 住在地極的人因你的神蹟懼怕； 你使日出日落之地都歡呼。
verses.en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.zh: 你眷顧地，降下透雨， 使地大得肥美。 上帝的河滿了水； 你這樣澆灌了地， 好為人預備五穀。
verses.en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

verses.zh: 你澆透地的犂溝，潤平犂脊， 降甘霖，使地軟和； 其中發長的，蒙你賜福。
verses.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

verses.zh: 你以恩典為年歲的冠冕； 你的路徑都滴下脂油，
verses.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.zh: 滴在曠野的草場上。 小山以歡樂束腰；
verses.en: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.zh: 草場以羊群為衣； 谷中也長滿了五穀。 這一切都歡呼歌唱。
verses.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.zh: 一篇詩歌，交與伶長。 全地都當向上帝歡呼！
verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

verses.zh: 歌頌他名的榮耀！ 用讚美的言語將他的榮耀發明！
verses.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.zh: 當對上帝說：你的作為何等可畏！ 因你的大能，仇敵要投降你。
verses.en: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

verses.zh: 全地要敬拜你，歌頌你， 要歌頌你的名。 （細拉）
verses.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

verses.zh: 你們來看上帝所行的， 他向世人所做之事是可畏的。
verses.en: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

verses.zh: 他將海變成乾地，眾民步行過河； 我們在那裏因他歡喜。
verses.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.zh: 他用權能治理[萬民]，直到永遠。 他的眼睛鑒察列邦； 悖逆的人不可自高。 （細拉）
verses.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.zh: 萬民哪，你們當稱頌我們的上帝， 使人得聽讚美他的聲音。
verses.en: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.zh: 他使我們的性命存活， 也不叫我們的腳搖動。
verses.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你曾試驗我們， 熬煉我們，如熬煉銀子一樣。
verses.en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.zh: 你使我們進入網羅， 把重擔放在我們的身上。
verses.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

verses.zh: 你使人坐車軋我們的頭； 我們經過水火， 你卻使我們到豐富之地。
verses.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

verses.zh: 我要用燔祭進你的殿， 向你還我的願，
verses.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

verses.zh: 就是在急難時我嘴唇所發的、 口中所許的。
verses.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

verses.zh: 我要把肥牛作燔祭， 將公羊的香祭獻給你， 又把公牛和山羊獻上。 （細拉）
verses.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

verses.zh: 凡敬畏上帝的人，你們都來聽！ 我要述說他為我所行的事。
verses.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

verses.zh: 我曾用口求告他； 我的舌頭也稱他為高。
verses.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.zh: 我若心裏注重罪孽， 主必不聽。
verses.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

verses.zh: 但上帝實在聽見了； 他側耳聽了我禱告的聲音。
verses.en: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.zh: 上帝是應當稱頌的！ 他並沒有推卻我的禱告， 也沒有叫他的慈愛離開我。
verses.en: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

verses.zh: 一篇詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。 願上帝憐憫我們，賜福與我們， 用臉光照我們， （細拉）
verses.en: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

verses.zh: 好叫世界得知你的道路， 萬國得知你的救恩。
verses.en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，願列邦稱讚你！ 願萬民都稱讚你！
verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.zh: 願萬國都快樂歡呼； 因為你必按公正審判萬民， 引導世上的萬國。 （細拉）
verses.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，願列邦稱讚你！ 願萬民都稱讚你！
verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.zh: 地已經出了土產； 上帝－就是我們的上帝要賜福與我們。
verses.en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

verses.zh: 上帝要賜福與我們； 地的四極都要敬畏他！
verses.en: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。 願上帝興起，使他的仇敵四散， 叫那恨他的人從他面前逃跑。
verses.en: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

verses.zh: 他們被驅逐，如煙被[風]吹散； 惡人見上帝之面而消滅，如蠟被火鎔化。
verses.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.zh: 惟有義人必然歡喜， 在上帝面前高興快樂。
verses.en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

verses.zh: 你們當向上帝唱詩，歌頌他的名； 為那坐車行過曠野的修平大路。 他的名是耶和華， 要在他面前歡樂！
verses.en: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.

verses.zh: 上帝在他的聖所作孤兒的父， 作寡婦的伸冤者。
verses.en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

verses.zh: 上帝叫孤獨的有家， 使被囚的出來享福； 惟有悖逆的住在乾燥之地。
verses.en: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你曾在你百姓前頭出來， 在曠野行走。 （細拉）
verses.en: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

verses.zh: 那時，地見上帝的面而震動，天也落雨； 西奈山見以色列上帝的面也震動。
verses.en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你降下大雨； 你產業[以色列]疲乏的時候，你使他堅固。
verses.en: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

verses.zh: 你的會眾住在其中； 上帝啊，你的恩惠是為困苦人預備的。
verses.en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

verses.zh: 主發命令， 傳好信息的婦女成了大群。
verses.en: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

verses.zh: 統兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了； 在家等候的婦女分受所奪的。
verses.en: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

verses.zh: 你們安臥在羊圈的時候， 好像鴿子的翅膀鍍白銀，翎毛鍍黃金一般。
verses.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

verses.zh: 全能者在境內趕散列王的時候， 勢如飄雪在撒們。
verses.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

verses.zh: 巴珊山是上帝的山； 巴珊山是多峰多嶺的山。
verses.en: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

verses.zh: 你們多峰多嶺的山哪， 為何斜看上帝所願居住的山？ 耶和華必住這山，直到永遠！
verses.en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.

verses.zh: 上帝的車輦累萬盈千； 主在其中，好像在西奈聖山一樣。
verses.en: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

verses.zh: 你已經升上高天，擄掠仇敵； 你在人間，就是在悖逆的人間，受了供獻， 叫耶和華上帝可以與他們同住。
verses.en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.

verses.zh: 天天背負我們重擔的主， 就是拯救我們的上帝， 是應當稱頌的！ （細拉）
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

verses.zh: 上帝是為我們施行諸般救恩的上帝； 人能脫離死亡是在乎主耶和華。
verses.en: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

verses.zh: 但上帝要打破他仇敵的頭， 就是那常犯罪之人的髮頂。
verses.en: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

verses.zh: 主說：我要使眾民從巴珊而歸， 使他們從深海而回，
verses.en: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

verses.zh: 使你打碎仇敵，你的腳踹在血中， 使你狗的舌頭從其中得分。
verses.en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你是我的上帝，我的王； 人已經看見你行走，進入聖所。
verses.en: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.zh: 歌唱的行在前，作樂的隨在後， 都在擊鼓的童女中間。
verses.en: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.zh: 從以色列源頭而來的， 當在各會中稱頌主上帝！
verses.en: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

verses.zh: 在那裏，有統管他們的小便雅憫， 有猶大的首領和他們的群眾， 有西布倫的首領， 有拿弗他利的首領。
verses.en: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

verses.zh: 以色列的能力是上帝所賜的； 上帝啊，求你堅固你為我們所成全的事！
verses.en: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

verses.zh: 因你耶路撒冷的殿， 列王必帶貢物獻給你。
verses.en: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

verses.zh: 求你叱喝蘆葦中的野獸和群公牛， 並列邦中的牛犢。 把銀塊踹在腳下； 上帝已經趕散好爭戰的列邦。
verses.en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

verses.zh: 埃及的公侯要出來朝見上帝； 古實人要急忙舉手 [禱告]。
verses.en: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

verses.zh: 世上的列國啊， 你們要向上帝歌唱； 願你們歌頌主！
verses.en: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

verses.zh: 歌頌那自古駕行在諸天以上的[主]！ 他發出聲音，是極大的聲音。
verses.en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

verses.zh: 你們要將能力歸給上帝。 他的威榮在以色列之上； 他的能力是在穹蒼。
verses.en: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你從聖所顯為可畏； 以色列的上帝是那將力量權能賜給他百姓的。 上帝是應當稱頌的！
verses.en: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。調用百合花。 上帝啊，求你救我！ 因為眾水要淹沒我。
verses.en: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

verses.zh: 我陷在深淤泥中，沒有立腳之地； 我到了深水中，大水漫過我身。
verses.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.zh: 我因呼求困乏，喉嚨發乾； 我因等候上帝，眼睛失明。
verses.en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.zh: 無故恨我的，比我頭髮還多； 無理與我為仇、要把我剪除的，甚為強盛。 我沒有搶奪的，要叫我償還。
verses.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，我的愚昧，你原知道； 我的罪愆不能隱瞞。
verses.en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

verses.zh: 萬軍的主－耶和華啊， 求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！ 以色列的上帝啊， 求你叫那尋求你的，不要因我受辱！
verses.en: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.zh: 因我為你的緣故受了辱罵， 滿面羞愧。
verses.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

verses.zh: 我的弟兄看我為外路人； 我的同胞看我為外邦人。
verses.en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

verses.zh: 因我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒， 並且辱罵你人的辱罵都落在我身上。
verses.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.zh: 我哭泣，以禁食[刻苦]我心； 這倒算為我的羞辱。
verses.en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.zh: 我拿麻布當衣裳， 就成了他們的笑談。
verses.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.zh: 坐在城門口的談論我； 酒徒也以我為歌曲。
verses.en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

verses.zh: 但我在悅納的時候向你－耶和華祈禱。 上帝啊，求你按你豐盛的慈愛， 憑你拯救的誠實應允我！
verses.en: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.zh: 求你搭救我出離淤泥， 不叫我陷在其中； 求你使我脫離那些恨我的人， 使我出離深水。
verses.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.zh: 求你不容大水漫過我， 不容深淵吞滅我， 不容坑坎在我以上合口。
verses.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你應允我！ 因為你的慈愛本為美好； 求你按你豐盛的慈悲回轉眷顧我！
verses.en: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.zh: 不要掩面不顧你的僕人； 我是在急難之中，求你速速地應允我！
verses.en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

verses.zh: 求你親近我，救贖我！ 求你因我的仇敵把我贖回！
verses.en: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

verses.zh: 你知道我受的辱罵、欺凌、羞辱； 我的敵人都在你面前。
verses.en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

verses.zh: 辱罵傷破了我的心， 我又滿了憂愁。 我指望有人體恤，卻沒有一個； 我指望有人安慰，卻找不着一個。
verses.en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.zh: 他們拿苦膽給我當食物； 我渴了，他們拿醋給我喝。
verses.en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.zh: 願他們的筵席在他們面前變為網羅， 在他們平安的時候變為機檻。
verses.en: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

verses.zh: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見； 願你使他們的腰常常戰抖。
verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.zh: 求你將你的惱恨倒在他們身上， 叫你的烈怒追上他們。
verses.en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.zh: 願他們的住處變為荒場； 願他們的帳棚無人居住。
verses.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

verses.zh: 因為，你所擊打的，他們就逼迫； 你所擊傷的，他們戲說他的愁苦。
verses.en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

verses.zh: 願你在他們的罪上加罪， 不容他們在你面前稱義。
verses.en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

verses.zh: 願他們從生命冊上被塗抹， 不得記錄在義人之中。
verses.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.zh: 但我是困苦憂傷的； 上帝啊，願你的救恩將我安置在高處。
verses.en: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.zh: 我要以詩歌讚美上帝的名， 以感謝稱他為大！
verses.en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.zh: 這便叫耶和華喜悅，勝似獻牛， 或是獻有角有蹄的公牛。
verses.en: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

verses.zh: 謙卑的人看見了就喜樂； 尋求上帝的人，願你們的心甦醒。
verses.en: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

verses.zh: 因為耶和華聽了窮乏人， 不藐視被囚的人。
verses.en: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.zh: 願天和地、 洋海和其中一切的動物都讚美他！
verses.en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

verses.zh: 因為上帝要拯救錫安，建造猶大的城邑； 他的民要在那裏居住，得以為業。
verses.en: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.zh: 他僕人的後裔要承受為業； 愛他名的人也要住在其中。
verses.en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.zh: 大衛的紀念詩，交與伶長。 上帝啊，求你[快快]搭救我！ 耶和華啊，求你速速幫助我！
verses.en: Make haste, o God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.

verses.zh: 願那些尋索我命的，抱愧蒙羞； 願那些喜悅我遭害的，退後受辱。
verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

verses.zh: 願那些對我說阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧退後。
verses.en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

verses.zh: 願一切尋求你的，因你高興歡喜； 願那些喜愛你救恩的，常說：當尊上帝為大！
verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

verses.zh: 但我是困苦窮乏的； 上帝啊，求你速速到我這裏來！ 你是幫助我的，搭救我的。 耶和華啊，求你不要耽延！
verses.en: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我投靠你； 求你叫我永不羞愧！
verses.en: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

verses.zh: 求你憑你的公義搭救我，救拔我； 側耳聽我，拯救我！
verses.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

verses.zh: 求你作我常住的磐石； 你已經命定要救我， 因為你是我的巖石，我的山寨。
verses.en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

verses.zh: 我的上帝啊，求你救我脫離惡人的手， 脫離不義和殘暴之人的手。
verses.en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.zh: 主－耶和華啊，你是我所盼望的； 從我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。
verses.en: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.

verses.zh: 我從出母胎被你扶持； 使我出母腹的是你。 我必常常讚美你！
verses.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

verses.zh: 許多人以我為怪， 但你是我堅固的避難所。
verses.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

verses.zh: 你的讚美，你的榮耀 終日必滿了我的口。
verses.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

verses.zh: 我年老的時候，求你不要丟棄我！ 我力氣衰弱的時候，求你不要離棄我！
verses.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

verses.zh: 我的仇敵議論我； 那些窺探要害我命的彼此商議，
verses.en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

verses.zh: 說：上帝已經離棄他； 我們追趕他，捉拿他吧！ 因為沒有人搭救。
verses.en: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，求你不要遠離我！ 我的上帝啊，求你速速幫助我！
verses.en: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

verses.zh: 願那與我性命為敵的，羞愧被滅； 願那謀害我的，受辱蒙羞。
verses.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

verses.zh: 我卻要常常盼望， 並要越發讚美你。
verses.en: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

verses.zh: 我的口終日要述說你的公義和你的救恩， 因我不計其數。
verses.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

verses.zh: 我要來[說]主－耶和華大能的事； 我單要提說你的公義。
verses.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，自我年幼時，你就教訓我； 直到如今，我傳揚你奇妙的作為。
verses.en: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，我到年老髮白的時候， 求你不要離棄我！ 等我將你的能力指示下代， 將你的大能指示後世的人。
verses.en: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你的公義甚高； 行過大事的上帝啊，誰能像你！
verses.en: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

verses.zh: 你是叫我們多經歷重大急難的， 必使我們復活， 從地的深處救上來。
verses.en: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.zh: 求你使我越發昌大， 又轉來安慰我。
verses.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

verses.zh: 我的上帝啊，我要鼓瑟稱讚你， 稱讚你的誠實！ 以色列的聖者啊，我要彈琴歌頌你！
verses.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

verses.zh: 我歌頌你的時候， 我的嘴唇和你所贖我的靈魂都必歡呼；
verses.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

verses.zh: 並且我的舌頭必終日講論你的公義， 因為那些謀害我的人已經蒙羞受辱了。
verses.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

verses.zh: 所羅門的詩。 上帝啊，求你將判斷的權柄賜給王， 將公義賜給王的兒子。
verses.en: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

verses.zh: 他要按公義審判你的民， 按公平審判你的困苦人。
verses.en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

verses.zh: 大山小山都要因公義使民得享平安。
