verses.zh: 你們一切被他造的， 在他所治理的各處， 都要稱頌耶和華！ 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！
verses.en: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.

verses.zh: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！ 耶和華－我的上帝啊，你為至大！ 你以尊榮威嚴為衣服，
verses.en: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

verses.zh: 披上亮光，如披外袍， 鋪張穹蒼，如鋪幔子，
verses.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.zh: 在水中立樓閣的棟樑， 用雲彩為車輦， 藉着風的翅膀而行，
verses.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

verses.zh: 以風為使者， 以火焰為僕役，
verses.en: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

verses.zh: 將地立在根基上， 使地永不動搖。
verses.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

verses.zh: 你用深水遮蓋地面，猶如衣裳； 諸水高過山嶺。
verses.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.zh: 你的斥責一發，水便奔逃； 你的雷聲一發，水便奔流。
verses.en: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

verses.zh: 諸山升上，諸谷沉下， 歸你為它所安定之地。
verses.en: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

verses.zh: 你定了界限，使水不能過去， 不再轉回遮蓋地面。
verses.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

verses.zh: 耶和華使泉源湧在山谷， 流在山間，
verses.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

verses.zh: 使野地的走獸有水喝， 野驢得解其渴。
verses.en: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

verses.zh: 天上的飛鳥在水旁住宿， 在樹枝上啼叫。
verses.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

verses.zh: 他從樓閣中澆灌山嶺； 因他作為的功效，地就豐足。
verses.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

verses.zh: 他使草生長，給六畜吃， 使菜蔬發長，供給人用， 使人從地裏能得食物，
verses.en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

verses.zh: 又得酒能悅人心， 得油能潤人面， 得糧能養人心。
verses.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.

verses.zh: 佳美的樹木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏樹， 是耶和華所栽種的，都滿了[汁漿]。
verses.en: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

verses.zh: 雀鳥在其上搭窩； 至於鶴，松樹是牠的房屋。
verses.en: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

verses.zh: 高山為野山羊[的住所]； 巖石為沙番的藏處。
verses.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

verses.zh: 你安置月亮為定節令； 日頭自知沉落。
verses.en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.zh: 你造黑暗為夜， 林中的百獸就都爬出來。
verses.en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

verses.zh: 少壯獅子吼叫，要抓食， 向上帝尋求食物。
verses.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

verses.zh: 日頭一出，獸便躲避， 臥在洞裏。
verses.en: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

verses.zh: 人出去做工， 勞碌直到晚上。
verses.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你所造的何其多！ 都是你用智慧造成的； 遍地滿了你的豐富。
verses.en: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

verses.zh: 那裏有海，又大又廣； 其中有無數的動物， 大小活物都有。
verses.en: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

verses.zh: 那裏有船行走， 有你所造的鱷魚游泳在其中。
verses.en: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

verses.zh: 這都仰望你按時給牠食物。
verses.en: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

verses.zh: 你給牠們，牠們便拾起來； 你張手，牠們飽得美食。
verses.en: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

verses.zh: 你掩面，牠們便驚惶； 你收回牠們的氣，牠們就死亡，歸於塵土。
verses.en: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

verses.zh: 你發出你的靈，牠們便受造； 你使地面更換為新。
verses.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

verses.zh: 願耶和華的榮耀存到永遠！ 願耶和華喜悅自己所造的！
verses.en: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

verses.zh: 他看地，地便震動； 他摸山，山就冒煙。
verses.en: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

verses.zh: 我要一生向耶和華唱詩！ 我還活的時候，要向我上帝歌頌！
verses.en: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.zh: 願他以我的默念為甘甜！ 我要因耶和華歡喜！
verses.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.

verses.zh: 願罪人從世上消滅！ 願惡人歸於無有！ 我的心哪，要稱頌耶和華！ 你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.zh: 你們要稱謝耶和華， 求告他的名， 在萬民中傳揚他的作為！
verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

verses.zh: 要向他唱詩歌頌， 談論他一切奇妙的作為！
verses.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

verses.zh: 要以他的聖名誇耀！ 尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜！
verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

verses.zh: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力， 時常尋求他的面。
verses.en: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

verses.zh: 他僕人亞伯拉罕的後裔， 他所揀選雅各的子孫哪， 你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事， 並他口中的判語。
verses.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

verses.zh: 他是耶和華－我們的上帝； 全地都有他的判斷。
verses.en: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.zh: 他記念他的約，直到永遠； 他所吩咐的話，直到千代－
verses.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.zh: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的[約]， 向以撒所起的誓。
verses.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

verses.zh: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例， 向以色列定為永遠的約，
verses.en: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

verses.zh: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你， 作你產業的分。
verses.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

verses.zh: 當時，他們人丁有限，數目稀少， 並且在那地為寄居的。
verses.en: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

verses.zh: 他們從這邦遊到那邦， 從這國行到那國。
verses.en: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

verses.zh: 他不容甚麼人欺負他們， 為他們的緣故責備君王，
verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

verses.zh: 說：不可難為我受膏的人， 也不可惡待我的先知。
verses.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.zh: 他命饑荒降在那地上， 將所倚靠的糧食全行斷絕，
verses.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

verses.zh: 在他們以先打發一個人去 －約瑟被賣為奴僕。
verses.en: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

verses.zh: 人用腳鐐傷他的腳； 他被鐵[鍊]捆拘。
verses.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

verses.zh: 耶和華的話試煉他， 直等到他所說的應驗了。
verses.en: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.

verses.zh: 王打發人把他解開， 就是治理眾民的，把他釋放，
verses.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

verses.zh: 立他作王家之主， 掌管他一切所有的，
verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

verses.zh: 使他隨意捆綁他的臣宰， 將智慧教導他的長老。
verses.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

verses.zh: 以色列也到了埃及； 雅各在含地寄居。
verses.en: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

verses.zh: 耶和華使他的百姓生養眾多， 使他們比敵人強盛，
verses.en: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

verses.zh: 使敵人的心轉去恨他的百姓， 並用詭計待他的僕人。
verses.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

verses.zh: 他打發他的僕人摩西 和他所揀選的亞倫，
verses.en: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

verses.zh: 在敵人中間顯他的神蹟， 在含地顯他的奇事。
verses.en: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.zh: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗； 沒有違背他話的。
verses.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

verses.zh: 他叫埃及的水變為血， 叫他們的魚死了。
verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.zh: 在他們的地上以及王宮的內室， 青蛙多多滋生。
verses.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.zh: 他說一聲，蒼蠅就成群而來， 並有虱子進入他們四境。
verses.en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

verses.zh: 他給他們降下冰雹為雨， 在他們的地上降下火焰。
verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.zh: 他也擊打他們的葡萄樹和無花果樹， 毀壞他們境內的樹木。
verses.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

verses.zh: 他說一聲，就有蝗蟲螞蚱上來， 不計其數，
verses.en: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

verses.zh: 吃盡了他們地上各樣的菜蔬 和田地的出產。
verses.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.zh: 他又擊殺他們國內一切的長子， 就是他們強壯時頭生的。
verses.en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.zh: 他領自己的百姓帶銀子金子出來； 他支派中沒有一個軟弱的。
verses.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

verses.zh: 他們出來的時候，埃及人便歡喜； 原來埃及人懼怕他們。
verses.en: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

verses.zh: 他鋪張雲彩當遮蓋， 夜間使火光照。
verses.en: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.zh: 他們一求，他就使鵪鶉飛來， 並用天上的糧食叫他們飽足。
verses.en: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

verses.zh: 他打開磐石，水就湧出； 在乾旱之處，水流成河。
verses.en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

verses.zh: 這都因他記念他的聖言 和他的僕人亞伯拉罕。
verses.en: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

verses.zh: 他帶領百姓歡樂而出， 帶領選民歡呼前往。
verses.en: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

verses.zh: 他將列國的地賜給他們， 他們便承受眾民勞碌得來的，
verses.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

verses.zh: 好使他們遵他的律例， 守他的律法。 你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.en: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善； 他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 誰能傳說耶和華的大能？ 誰能表明他一切的美德？
verses.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?

verses.zh: 凡遵守公平、常行公義的， 這人便為有福！
verses.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓； 求你也用這恩惠記念我，開你的救恩眷顧我，
verses.en: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

verses.zh: 使我見你選民的福， 樂你國民的樂， 與你的產業一同誇耀。
verses.en: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

verses.zh: 我們與我們的祖宗一同犯罪； 我們作了孽，行了惡。
verses.en: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.zh: 我們的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事， 不記念你豐盛的慈愛， 反倒在紅海行了悖逆。
verses.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

verses.zh: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他們， 為要彰顯他的大能，
verses.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

verses.zh: 並且斥責紅海，海便乾了； 他帶領他們經過深處，如同經過曠野。
verses.en: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

verses.zh: 他拯救他們脫離恨他們人的手， 從仇敵手中救贖他們。
verses.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.zh: 水淹沒他們的敵人， 沒有一個存留。
verses.en: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

verses.zh: 那時，他們才信了他的話， 歌唱讚美他。
verses.en: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

verses.zh: 等不多時，他們就忘了他的作為， 不仰望他的指教，
verses.en: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

verses.zh: 反倒在曠野大起慾心， 在荒地試探上帝。
verses.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

verses.zh: 他將他們所求的賜給他們， 卻使他們的心靈軟弱。
verses.en: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.zh: 他們又在營中嫉妒摩西 和耶和華的聖者亞倫。
verses.en: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.

verses.zh: 地裂開，吞下大坍， 掩蓋亞比蘭一黨的人。
verses.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.zh: 有火在他們的黨中發起； 有火焰燒毀了惡人。
verses.en: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.zh: 他們在何烈山造了牛犢， 叩拜鑄成的像。
verses.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

verses.zh: 如此將他們榮耀[的主] 換為吃草之牛的像，
verses.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

verses.zh: 忘了上帝－他們的救主； 他曾在埃及行大事，
verses.en: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

verses.zh: 在含地行奇事， 在紅海行可畏的事。
verses.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

verses.zh: 所以，他說要滅絕他們； 若非有他所揀選的摩西站在當中， 使他的忿怒轉消， 恐怕他就滅絕他們。
verses.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

verses.zh: 他們又藐視那美地， 不信他的話，
verses.en: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

verses.zh: 在自己帳棚內發怨言， 不聽耶和華的聲音。
verses.en: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.

verses.zh: 所以，他對他們起誓： 必叫他們倒在曠野，
verses.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

verses.zh: 叫他們的後裔倒在列國之中， 分散在各地。
verses.en: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

verses.zh: 他們又與巴力‧毗珥連合， 且吃了祭死神的物。
verses.en: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.zh: 他們這樣行，惹耶和華發怒， 便有瘟疫流行在他們中間。
verses.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

verses.zh: 那時，非尼哈站起，刑罰惡人， 瘟疫這才止息。
verses.en: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

verses.zh: 那就算為他的義， 世世代代，直到永遠。
verses.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

verses.zh: 他們在米利巴水又叫耶和華發怒， 甚至摩西也受了虧損，
verses.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

verses.zh: 是因他們惹動他的靈， 摩西用嘴說了急躁的話。
verses.en: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

verses.zh: 他們不照耶和華所吩咐的 滅絕外邦人，
verses.en: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:

verses.zh: 反與他們混雜相合， 學習他們的行為，
verses.en: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

verses.zh: 事奉他們的偶像， 這就成了自己的網羅，
verses.en: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

verses.zh: 把自己的兒女祭祀鬼魔，
verses.en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

verses.zh: 流無辜人的血， 就是自己兒女的血， 把他們祭祀迦南的偶像， 那地就被血污穢了。
verses.en: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.zh: 這樣，他們被自己所做的污穢了， 在行為上犯了邪淫。
verses.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

verses.zh: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作， 憎惡他的產業，
verses.en: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

verses.zh: 將他們交在外邦人的手裏； 恨他們的人就轄制他們。
verses.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.zh: 他們的仇敵也欺壓他們， 他們就伏在敵人手下。
verses.en: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

verses.zh: 他屢次搭救他們， 他們卻設謀背逆， 因自己的罪孽降為卑下。
verses.en: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

verses.zh: 然而，他聽見他們哀告的時候， 就眷顧他們的急難，
verses.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

verses.zh: 為他們記念他的約， 照他豐盛的慈愛後悔。
verses.en: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.zh: 他也使他們在凡擄掠他們的人面前蒙憐恤。
verses.en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我們的上帝啊，求你拯救我們， 從外邦中招聚我們， 我們好稱讚你的聖名， 以讚美你為誇勝。
verses.en: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

verses.zh: 耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的， 從亙古直到永遠。 願眾民都說：阿們！ 你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.zh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善； 他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 願耶和華的贖民說這話， 就是他從敵人手中所救贖的，
verses.en: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

verses.zh: 從各地，從東從西， 從南從北，所招聚來的。
verses.en: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

verses.zh: 他們在曠野荒地漂流， 尋不見可住的城邑，
verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.zh: 又飢又渴， 心裏發昏。
verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.zh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華； 他從他們的禍患中搭救他們，
verses.en: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.zh: 又領他們行走直路， 使他們往可居住的城邑。
verses.en: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.zh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛 和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；
verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.zh: 因他使心裏渴慕的人得以知足， 使心裏飢餓的人得飽美物。
verses.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

verses.zh: 那些坐在黑暗中、死蔭裏的人 被困苦和鐵[鍊]捆鎖，
verses.en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

verses.zh: 是因他們違背上帝的話語， 藐視至高者的旨意。
verses.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

verses.zh: 所以，他用勞苦治服他們的心； 他們仆倒，無人扶助。
verses.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

verses.zh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華； 他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。
verses.en: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.zh: 他從黑暗中和死蔭裏領他們出來， 折斷他們的綁索。
verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

verses.zh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛 和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他；
verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.zh: 因為他打破了銅門， 砍斷了鐵閂。
verses.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.zh: 愚妄人因自己的過犯 和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。
verses.en: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

verses.zh: 他們心裏厭惡各樣的食物， 就臨近死門。
verses.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

verses.zh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華； 他從他們的禍患中拯救他們。
verses.en: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

verses.zh: 他發命醫治他們， 救他們脫離死亡。
verses.en: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.zh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛 和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。
verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.zh: 願他們以感謝為祭獻給他， 歡呼述說他的作為！
verses.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

verses.zh: 在海上坐船， 在大水中經理事務的，
verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

verses.zh: 他們看見耶和華的作為， 並他在深水中的奇事。
verses.en: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

verses.zh: 因他一吩咐，狂風就起來， 海中的波浪也揚起。
verses.en: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

verses.zh: 他們上到天空，下到海底； 他們的心因患難便消化。
verses.en: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

verses.zh: 他們搖搖晃晃，東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 他們的智慧無法可施。
verses.en: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.

verses.zh: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華， 他從他們的禍患中領出他們來。
verses.en: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

verses.zh: 他使狂風止息， 波浪就平靜。
verses.en: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

verses.zh: 風息浪靜，他們便歡喜； 他就引他們到所願去的海口。
verses.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

verses.zh: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛 和他向人所行的奇事都稱讚他。
verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.zh: 願他們在民的會中尊崇他， 在長老的位上讚美他！
verses.en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

verses.zh: 他使江河變為曠野， 叫水泉變為乾渴之地，
verses.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

verses.zh: 使肥地變為鹼地； 這都因其間居民的罪惡。
verses.en: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.zh: 他使曠野變為水潭， 叫旱地變為水泉。
verses.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

verses.zh: 他使飢餓的人住在那裏， 好建造可住的城邑，
verses.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

verses.zh: 又種田地，栽葡萄園， 得享所出的土產。
verses.en: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

verses.zh: 他又賜福給他們，叫他們生養眾多， 也不叫他們的牲畜減少。
verses.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

verses.zh: 他們又因暴虐、患難、愁苦， 就減少且卑下。
verses.en: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

verses.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱， 使他們在荒廢無路之地漂流。
verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

verses.zh: 他卻將窮乏人安置在高處，脫離苦難， 使他的家屬多如羊群。
verses.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

verses.zh: 正直人看見就歡喜； 罪孽之輩必塞口無言。
verses.en: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.zh: 凡有智慧的，必在這些事上留心， 也必思想耶和華的慈愛。
verses.en: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩歌。 上帝啊，我心堅定； 我口要唱詩歌頌！
verses.en: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

verses.zh: 琴瑟啊，你們當醒起！ 我自己要極早醒起！
verses.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你， 在列邦中歌頌你！
verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

verses.zh: 因為，你的慈愛大過諸天； 你的誠實達到穹蒼。
verses.en: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.zh: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！ 願你的榮耀高過全地！
verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

verses.zh: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們， 好叫你所親愛的人得救。
verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.zh: 上帝已經指着他的聖潔說： 我要歡樂；我要分開示劍， 丈量疏割谷。
verses.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.zh: 基列是我的； 瑪拿西是我的； 以法蓮是護衛我頭的； 猶大是我的杖；
verses.en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以東拋鞋； 我必因勝非利士呼喊。
verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.zh: 誰能領我進堅固城？ 誰能引我到以東地？
verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.zh: 上帝啊，你不是丟棄了我們嗎？ 上帝啊，你不和我們的軍兵同去嗎？
verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

verses.zh: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人， 因為人的幫助是枉然的。
verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.zh: 我們倚靠上帝才得施展大能， 因為踐踏我們敵人的就是他。
verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。 我所讚美的上帝啊， 求你不要閉口不言。
verses.en: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.zh: 因為惡人的嘴和詭詐人的口已經張開攻擊我； 他們用撒謊的舌頭對我說話。
verses.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.zh: 他們圍繞我，說怨恨的話， 又無故地攻打我。
verses.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.zh: 他們與我為敵以報我愛， 但我[專心]祈禱。
verses.en: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

verses.zh: 他們向我以惡報善， 以恨報愛。
verses.en: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.zh: 願你派一個惡人轄制他， 派一個對頭站在他右邊！
verses.en: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.zh: 他受審判的時候， 願他出來擔當罪名！ 願他的祈禱反成為罪！
verses.en: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

verses.zh: 願他的年日短少！ 願別人得他的職分！
verses.en: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

verses.zh: 願他的兒女為孤兒， 他的妻子為寡婦！
verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.zh: 願他的兒女漂流討飯， 從他們荒涼之處出來求[食]！
verses.en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

verses.zh: 願強暴的債主牢籠他一切所有的！ 願外人搶他勞碌得來的！
verses.en: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.zh: 願無人向他延綿施恩！ 願無人可憐他的孤兒！
verses.en: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.zh: 願他的後人斷絕， 名字被塗抹，不傳於下代！
verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.zh: 願他祖宗的罪孽被耶和華記念！ 願他母親的罪過不被塗抹！
verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.zh: 願這些罪常在耶和華面前， 使他的名號斷絕於世！
verses.en: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.zh: 因為他不想施恩， 卻逼迫困苦窮乏的和傷心的人， 要把他們治死。
verses.en: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.zh: 他愛咒罵，咒罵就臨到他； 他不喜愛福樂，福樂就與他遠離！
verses.en: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.zh: 他拿咒罵當衣服穿上； 這咒罵就如水進他裏面， 像油入他的骨頭。
verses.en: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.zh: 願這咒罵當他遮身的衣服， 當他常束的腰帶！
verses.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.zh: 這就是我對頭和用惡言議論我的人 從耶和華那裏所受的報應。
verses.en: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.zh: 主－耶和華啊，求你為你的名[恩]待我； 因你的慈愛美好，求你搭救我！
verses.en: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

verses.zh: 因為我困苦窮乏， 內心受傷。
verses.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.zh: 我如日影漸漸偏斜而去； 我如蝗蟲被抖出來。
verses.en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.zh: 我因禁食，膝骨軟弱； 我身上的肉也漸漸瘦了。
verses.en: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.zh: 我受他們的羞辱， 他們看見我便搖頭。
verses.en: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.zh: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你幫助我， 照你的慈愛拯救我，
verses.en: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.zh: 使他們知道這是你的手， 是你－耶和華所行的事。
verses.en: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.

verses.zh: 任憑他們咒罵，惟願你賜福； 他們幾時起來就必蒙羞， 你的僕人卻要歡喜。
verses.en: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.zh: 願我的對頭披戴羞辱！ 願他們以自己的羞愧為外袍遮身！
verses.en: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.zh: 我要用口極力稱謝耶和華； 我要在眾人中間讚美他；
verses.en: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.zh: 因為他必站在窮乏人的右邊， 要救他脫離審判他靈魂的人。
verses.en: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

verses.zh: 大衛的詩。 耶和華對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
verses.en: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.zh: 耶和華必使你從錫安伸出能力的杖來； 你要在你仇敵中掌權。
verses.en: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.zh: 當你掌權的日子， 你的民要以聖潔的妝飾為衣， 甘心犧牲自己； 你的民多如清晨的甘露。
verses.en: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

verses.zh: 耶和華起了誓，決不後悔，[說]： 你是照着麥基洗德的等次永遠為祭司。
verses.en: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.zh: 在你右邊的主， 當他發怒的日子，必打傷列王。
verses.en: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.zh: 他要在列邦中刑罰[惡人]， 屍首就遍滿[各處]； 他要在許多國中打破[仇敵的]頭。
verses.en: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

verses.zh: 他要喝路旁的河水， 因此必抬起頭來。
verses.en: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

verses.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 我要在正直人的大會中，並公會中， 一心稱謝耶和華。
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.zh: 耶和華的作為本為大； 凡喜愛的都必考察。
verses.en: The works of the Lord are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

verses.zh: 他所行的是尊榮和威嚴； 他的公義存到永遠。
verses.en: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 他行了奇事，使人記念； 耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫。
verses.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.zh: 他賜糧食給敬畏他的人； 他必永遠記念他的約。
verses.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.zh: 他向百姓顯出大能的作為， 把外邦的地賜給他們為業。
verses.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.zh: 他手所行的是誠實公平； 他的訓詞都是確實的，
verses.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

verses.zh: 是永永遠遠堅定的， 是按誠實正直設立的。
verses.en: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.zh: 他向百姓施行救贖， 命定他的約，直到永遠； 他的名聖而可畏。
verses.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端； 凡遵行[他命令]的是聰明人。 耶和華是永遠當讚美的！
verses.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 敬畏耶和華，甚喜愛他命令的， 這人便為有福！
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

verses.zh: 他的後裔在世必強盛； 正直人的後代必要蒙福。
verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.zh: 他家中有貨物，有錢財； 他的公義存到永遠。
verses.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他發現； 他有恩惠，有憐憫，有公義。
verses.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.zh: 施恩與人、借貸與人的，這人事情順利； 他被審判的時候要訴明自己的冤。
verses.en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

verses.zh: 他永不動搖； 義人被記念，直到永遠。
verses.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.zh: 他必不怕凶惡的信息； 他心堅定，倚靠耶和華。
verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.

verses.zh: 他心確定，總不懼怕， 直到他看見敵人[遭報]。
verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

verses.zh: 他施捨[錢財]，賙濟貧窮； 他的仁義存到永遠。 他的角必被高舉，大有榮耀。
verses.en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

verses.zh: 惡人看見便惱恨，必咬牙而消化； 惡人的心願要歸滅絕。
verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 耶和華的僕人哪，你們要讚美， 讚美耶和華的名！
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

verses.zh: 耶和華的名是應當稱頌的， 從今時直到永遠！
verses.en: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.zh: 從日出之地到日落之處， 耶和華的名是應當讚美的！
verses.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord's name is to be praised.

verses.zh: 耶和華超乎萬民之上； 他的榮耀高過諸天。
verses.en: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

verses.zh: 誰像耶和華－我們的上帝呢？ 他坐在至高之處，
verses.en: Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,

verses.zh: 自己謙卑， 觀看天上地下的事。
verses.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.zh: 他從灰塵裏抬舉貧寒人， 從糞堆中提拔窮乏人，
verses.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.zh: 使他們與王子同坐， 就是與本國的王子同坐。
verses.en: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

verses.zh: 他使不能生育的婦人安居家中， 為多子的樂母。 你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.zh: 以色列出了埃及， 雅各家離開說異言之民；
verses.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.zh: 那時，猶大為主的聖所， 以色列為他所治理的國度。
verses.en: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

verses.zh: 滄海看見就奔逃； 約旦河也倒流。
verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

verses.zh: 大山踴躍，如公羊； 小山跳舞，如羊羔。
verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

verses.zh: 滄海啊，你為何奔逃？ 約旦哪，你為何倒流？
verses.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

verses.zh: 大山哪，你為何踴躍，如公羊？ 小山哪，你為何跳舞，如羊羔？
verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

verses.zh: 大地啊，你因見主的面， 就是雅各上帝的面，便要震動。
verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

verses.zh: 他叫磐石變為水池， 叫堅石變為泉源。
verses.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，榮耀不要歸與我們， 不要歸與我們； 要因你的慈愛和誠實歸在你的名下！
verses.en: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.

verses.zh: 為何容外邦人說： 他們的上帝在哪裏呢？
verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

verses.zh: 然而，我們的上帝在天上， 都隨自己的意旨行事。
verses.en: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

verses.zh: 他們的偶像是金的，銀的， 是人手所造的，
verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.zh: 有口卻不能言， 有眼卻不能看，
verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

verses.zh: 有耳卻不能聽， 有鼻卻不能聞，
verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

verses.zh: 有手卻不能摸， 有腳卻不能走， 有喉嚨也不能出聲。
verses.en: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

verses.zh: 造他的要和他一樣； 凡靠他的也要如此。
verses.en: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

verses.zh: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和華！ 他是你的幫助和你的盾牌。
verses.en: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.zh: 亞倫家啊，你們要倚靠耶和華！ 他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。
verses.en: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.zh: 你們敬畏耶和華的，要倚靠耶和華！ 他是你們的幫助和你們的盾牌。
verses.en: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.zh: 耶和華向來眷念我們； 他還要賜福[給我們]： 要賜福給以色列的家， 賜福給亞倫的家。
verses.en: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.zh: 凡敬畏耶和華的，無論大小， 主必賜福給他。
verses.en: He will bless them that fear the Lord, both small and great.

verses.zh: 願耶和華叫你們 和你們的子孫日見加增。
verses.en: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.zh: 你們蒙了造天地之耶和華的福！
verses.en: Ye are blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.

verses.zh: 天，是耶和華的天； 地，他卻給了世人。
verses.en: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

verses.zh: 死人不能讚美耶和華； 下到寂靜中的也都不能。
verses.en: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.

verses.zh: 但我們要稱頌耶和華， 從今時直到永遠。 你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.en: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.

verses.zh: 我愛耶和華， 因為他聽了我的聲音和我的懇求。
verses.en: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

verses.zh: 他既向我側耳， 我一生要求告他。
verses.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

verses.zh: 死亡的繩索纏繞我； 陰間的痛苦抓住我； 我遭遇患難愁苦。
verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.zh: 那時，我便求告耶和華的名，說： 耶和華啊，求你救我的靈魂！
verses.en: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

verses.zh: 耶和華有恩惠，有公義； 我們的上帝以憐憫為懷。
verses.en: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

verses.zh: 耶和華保護愚人； 我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。
verses.en: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

verses.zh: 我的心哪！你要仍歸安樂， 因為耶和華用厚恩待你。
verses.en: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.zh: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡， 救我的眼免了流淚， 救我的腳免了跌倒。
verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.zh: 我要在耶和華面前行活人之路。
verses.en: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.zh: 我因信，所以如此說話； 我受了極大的困苦。
verses.en: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

verses.zh: 我曾急促地說： 人都是說謊的！
verses.en: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

verses.zh: 我拿甚麼報答耶和華向我所賜的一切厚恩？
verses.en: What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

verses.zh: 我要舉起救恩的杯， 稱揚耶和華的名。
verses.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.zh: 我要在他眾民面前向耶和華還我的願。
verses.en: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.

verses.zh: 在耶和華眼中， 看聖民之死極為寶貴。
verses.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我真是你的僕人； 我是你的僕人，是你婢女的兒子。 你已經解開我的綁索。
verses.en: O Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

verses.zh: 我要以感謝為祭獻給你， 又要求告耶和華的名。
verses.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.zh: 我要在他眾民面前， 在耶和華殿的院內， 在耶路撒冷當中， 向耶和華還我的願。 你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.en: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.
In the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.zh: 萬國啊，你們都當讚美耶和華！ 萬民哪，你們都當頌讚他！
verses.en: O praise the Lord, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

verses.zh: 因為他向我們大施慈愛； 耶和華的誠實存到永遠。 你們要讚美耶和華！
verses.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praise ye the Lord.

verses.zh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善； 他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 願以色列說： 他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.en: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 願亞倫的家說： 他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.en: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 願敬畏耶和華的說： 他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.en: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 我在急難中求告耶和華，他就應允我， 把我[安置]在寬闊之地。
verses.en: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me, and set me in a large place.

verses.zh: 有耶和華幫助我，我必不懼怕， 人能把我怎麼樣呢？
verses.en: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

verses.zh: 在那幫助我的人中，有耶和華幫助我， 所以我要看見那恨我的人[遭報]。
verses.en: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

verses.zh: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴人；
verses.en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.

verses.zh: 投靠耶和華，強似倚賴王子。
verses.en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.

verses.zh: 萬民圍繞我， 我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。
verses.en: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.

verses.zh: 他們環繞我，圍困我， 我靠耶和華的名必剿滅他們。
verses.en: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

verses.zh: 他們如同蜂子圍繞我， 好像燒荊棘的火，必被熄滅； 我靠耶和華的名，必剿滅他們。
verses.en: They compassed me about like bees: they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

verses.zh: 你推我，要叫我跌倒， 但耶和華幫助了我。
verses.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

verses.zh: 耶和華是我的力量，是我的詩歌； 他也成了我的拯救。
verses.en: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.zh: 在義人的帳棚裏，有歡呼拯救的聲音； 耶和華的右手施展大能。
verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

verses.zh: 耶和華的右手高舉； 耶和華的右手施展大能。
verses.en: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

verses.zh: 我必不致死，仍要存活， 並要傳揚耶和華的作為。
verses.en: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

verses.zh: 耶和華雖嚴嚴地懲治我， 卻未曾將我交於死亡。
verses.en: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

verses.zh: 給我敞開義門； 我要進去稱謝耶和華！
verses.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:

verses.zh: 這是耶和華的門； 義人要進去！
verses.en: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.zh: 我要稱謝你，因為你已經應允我， 又成了我的拯救！
verses.en: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

verses.zh: 匠人所棄的石頭 已成了房角的頭塊石頭。
verses.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

verses.zh: 這是耶和華所做的， 在我們眼中看為希奇。
verses.en: This is the Lord's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.zh: 這是耶和華所定的日子， 我們在其中要高興歡喜！
verses.en: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你拯救！ 耶和華啊，求你使我們亨通！
verses.en: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

verses.zh: 奉耶和華名來的是應當稱頌的！ 我們從耶和華的殿中為你們祝福！
verses.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

verses.zh: 耶和華是上帝； 他光照了我們。 理當用繩索把祭牲拴住， [牽]到壇角那裏。
verses.en: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.zh: 你是我的上帝，我要稱謝你！ 你是我的上帝，我要尊崇你！
verses.en: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

verses.zh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善； 他的慈愛永遠長存！
verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 行為完全、遵行耶和華律法的， 這人便為有福！
verses.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.

verses.zh: 遵守他的法度、一心尋求他的， 這人便為有福！
verses.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

verses.zh: 這人不做非義的事， 但遵行他的道。
verses.en: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你曾將你的訓詞吩咐我們， 為要我們殷勤遵守。
verses.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

verses.zh: 但願我行事堅定， 得以遵守你的律例。
verses.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

verses.zh: 我看重你的一切命令， 就不至於羞愧。
verses.en: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

verses.zh: 我學了你公義的判語， 就要以正直的心稱謝你。
verses.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

verses.zh: 我必守你的律例； 求你總不要丟棄我！
verses.en: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

verses.zh: 少年人用甚麼潔淨他的行為呢？ 是要遵行你的話！
verses.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

verses.zh: 我一心尋求了你； 求你不要叫我偏離你的命令。
verses.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

verses.zh: 我將你的話藏在心裏， 免得我得罪你。
verses.en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你是應當稱頌的！ 求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.en: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.

verses.zh: 我用嘴唇傳揚你口中的一切典章。
verses.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

verses.zh: 我喜悅你的法度， 如同喜悅一切的財物。
verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.zh: 我要默想你的訓詞， 看重你的道路。
verses.en: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

verses.zh: 我要在你的律例中自樂； 我不忘記你的話。
verses.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

verses.zh: 求你用厚恩待你的僕人，使我存活， 我就遵守你的話。
verses.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

verses.zh: 求你開我的眼睛， 使我看出你律法中的奇妙。
verses.en: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

verses.zh: 我是在地上作寄居的； 求你不要向我隱瞞你的命令！
verses.en: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

verses.zh: 我時常切慕你的典章， 甚至心碎。
verses.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

verses.zh: 受咒詛、偏離你命令的驕傲人， 你已經責備他們。
verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

verses.zh: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐視， 因我遵守你的法度。
verses.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 雖有首領坐着妄論我， 你僕人卻思想你的律例。
verses.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

verses.zh: 你的法度是我所喜樂的， 是我的謀士。
verses.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counselors.

verses.zh: 我的性命幾乎歸於塵土； 求你照你的話將我救活！
verses.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

verses.zh: 我述說我所行的，你應允了我； 求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.en: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

verses.zh: 求你使我明白你的訓詞， 我就思想你的奇事。
verses.en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

verses.zh: 我的心因愁苦而消化； 求你照你的話使我堅立！
verses.en: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

verses.zh: 求你使我離開奸詐的道， 開恩將你的律法賜給我！
verses.en: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

verses.zh: 我揀選了忠信的道， 將你的典章擺在[我面前]。
verses.en: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

verses.zh: 我持守你的法度； 耶和華啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！
verses.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

verses.zh: 你開廣我心的時候， 我就往你命令的道上直奔。
verses.en: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的律例指教我， 我必遵守到底！
verses.en: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

verses.zh: 求你賜我悟性，我便遵守你的律法， 且要一心遵守。
verses.en: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

verses.zh: 求你叫我遵行你的命令， 因為這是我所喜樂的。
verses.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.zh: 求你使我的心趨向你的法度， 不趨向非義之財。
verses.en: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.zh: 求你叫我轉眼不看虛假， 又叫我在你的道中生活。
verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

verses.zh: 你向敬畏你的人所應許的話， 求你向僕人堅定！
verses.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

verses.zh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱遠離我， 因你的典章本為美。
verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

verses.zh: 我羨慕你的訓詞； 求你使我在你的公義上生活！
verses.en: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，願你照你的話，使你的慈愛， 就是你的救恩，臨到我身上，
verses.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

verses.zh: 我就有話回答那羞辱我的， 因我倚靠你的話。
verses.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

verses.zh: 求你叫真理的話總不離開我口， 因我仰望你的典章。
verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

verses.zh: 我要常守你的律法， 直到永永遠遠。
verses.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

verses.zh: 我要自由而行， 因我素來考究你的訓詞。
verses.en: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

verses.zh: 我也要在君王面前論說你的法度， 並不至於羞愧。
verses.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.zh: 我要在你的命令中自樂； 這命令素來是我所愛的。
verses.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.zh: 我又要遵行你的命令， 這命令素來是我所愛的； 我也要思想你的律例。
verses.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

verses.zh: 求你記念向你僕人[所應許]的話， 叫我有盼望。
verses.en: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

verses.zh: 這話將我救活了； 我在患難中，因此得安慰。
verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

verses.zh: 驕傲的人甚侮慢我， 我卻未曾偏離你的律法。
verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我記念你從古以來的典章， 就得了安慰。
verses.en: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.

verses.zh: 我見惡人離棄你的律法， 就怒氣發作，猶如火燒。
verses.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

verses.zh: 我在世寄居， 素來以你的律例為詩歌。
verses.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名， 遵守你的律法。
verses.en: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.

verses.zh: 我所以如此， 是因我守你的訓詞。
verses.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

verses.zh: 耶和華是我的福分； 我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。
verses.en: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.

verses.zh: 我一心求過你的恩； 願你照你的話憐憫我！
verses.en: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

verses.zh: 我思想我所行的道， 就轉步歸向你的法度。
verses.en: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 我急忙遵守你的命令， 並不遲延。
verses.en: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

verses.zh: 惡人的繩索纏繞我， 我卻沒有忘記你的律法。
verses.en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.zh: 我因你公義的典章， 半夜必起來稱謝你。
verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.zh: 凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人， 我都與他作伴。
verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地； 求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.en: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你向來是照你的話善待僕人。
verses.en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.

verses.zh: 求你將精明和知識賜給我， 因我信了你的命令。
verses.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

verses.zh: 我未受苦以先走迷了路， 現在卻遵守你的話。
verses.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

verses.zh: 你本為善，所行的也善； 求你將你的律例教訓我！
verses.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

verses.zh: 驕傲人編造謊言攻擊我， 我卻要一心守你的訓詞。
verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

verses.zh: 他們心蒙脂油， 我卻喜愛你的律法。
verses.en: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

verses.zh: 我受苦是與我有益， 為要使我學習你的律例。
verses.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

verses.zh: 你口中的訓言與我有益， 勝於千萬的金銀。
verses.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.zh: 你的手製造我，建立我； 求你賜我悟性，可以學習你的命令！
verses.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

verses.zh: 敬畏你的人見我就要歡喜， 因我仰望你的話。
verses.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我知道你的判語是公義的； 你使我受苦是以誠實待我。
verses.en: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

verses.zh: 求你照着[應許]僕人的話， 以慈愛安慰我。
verses.en: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

verses.zh: 願你的慈悲臨到我，使我存活， 因你的律法是我所喜愛的。
verses.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

verses.zh: 願驕傲人蒙羞，因為他們無理地傾覆我； 但我要思想你的訓詞。
verses.en: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

verses.zh: 願敬畏你的人歸向我， 他們就知道你的法度。
verses.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 願我的心在你的律例上完全， 使我不致蒙羞。
verses.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

verses.zh: 我心渴想你的救恩， 仰望你的應許。
verses.en: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

verses.zh: 我因盼望你的應許眼睛失明，說： 你何時安慰我？
verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

verses.zh: 我好像煙薰的皮袋， 卻不忘記你的律例。
verses.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

verses.zh: 你僕人的年日有多少呢？ 你幾時向逼迫我的人施行審判呢？
verses.en: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.zh: 不從你律法的驕傲人為我掘了坑。
verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

verses.zh: 你的命令盡都誠實； 他們無理地逼迫我，求你幫助我！
verses.en: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

verses.zh: 他們幾乎把我從世上滅絕， 但我沒有離棄你的訓詞。
verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

verses.zh: 求你照你的慈愛將我救活， 我就遵守你口中的法度。
verses.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你的話安定在天， 直到永遠。
verses.en: For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.

verses.zh: 你的誠實存到萬代； 你堅定了地，地就長存。
verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

verses.zh: 天地照你的安排存到今日； 萬物都是你的僕役。
verses.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

verses.zh: 我若不是喜愛你的律法， 早就在苦難中滅絕了！
verses.en: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

verses.zh: 我永不忘記你的訓詞， 因你用這訓詞將我救活了。
verses.en: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

verses.zh: 我是屬你的，求你救我， 因我尋求了你的訓詞。
verses.en: I am thine, save me: for I have sought thy precepts.

verses.zh: 惡人等待我，要滅絕我， 我卻要揣摩你的法度。
verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 我看萬事盡都有限， 惟有你的命令極其寬廣。
verses.en: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

verses.zh: 我何等愛慕你的律法， 終日不住地思想。
verses.en: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

verses.zh: 你的命令常存在我心裏， 使我比仇敵有智慧。
verses.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

verses.zh: 我比我的師傅更通達， 因我思想你的法度。
verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

verses.zh: 我比年老的更明白， 因我守了你的訓詞。
verses.en: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

verses.zh: 我禁止我腳走一切的邪路， 為要遵守你的話。
verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

verses.zh: 我沒有偏離你的典章， 因為你教訓了我。
verses.en: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

verses.zh: 你的言語在我上膛何等甘美， 在我口中比蜜更甜！
verses.en: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.zh: 我藉着你的訓詞得以明白， 所以我恨一切的假道。
verses.en: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

verses.zh: 你的話是我腳前的燈， 是我路上的光。
verses.en: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.zh: 你公義的典章，我曾起誓遵守， 我必按誓而行。
verses.en: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

verses.zh: 我甚是受苦； 耶和華啊，求你照你的話將我救活！
verses.en: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你悅納我口中的讚美為供物， 又將你的典章教訓我！
verses.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.

verses.zh: 我的性命常在危險之中， 我卻不忘記你的律法。
verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.zh: 惡人為我設下網羅， 我卻沒有偏離你的訓詞。
verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

verses.zh: 我以你的法度為永遠的產業， 因這是我心中所喜愛的。
verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.zh: 我的心專向你的律例， 永遠遵行，一直到底。
verses.en: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

verses.zh: 心懷二意的人為我所恨； 但你的律法為我所愛。
verses.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

verses.zh: 你是我藏身之處，又是我的盾牌； 我甚仰望你的話語。
verses.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

verses.zh: 作惡的人哪，你們離開我吧！ 我好遵守我上帝的命令。
verses.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.zh: 求你照你的話扶持我，使我存活， 也不叫我因失望而害羞。
verses.en: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.zh: 求你扶持我，我便得救， 時常看重你的律例。
verses.en: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

verses.zh: 凡偏離你律例的人，你都輕棄他們， 因為他們的詭詐必歸虛空。
verses.en: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

verses.zh: 凡地上的惡人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓； 因此我愛你的法度。
verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 我因懼怕你，肉就發抖； 我也怕你的判語。
verses.en: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

verses.zh: 我行過公平和公義， 求你不要撇下我給欺壓我的人！
verses.en: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

verses.zh: 求你為僕人作保，使我得好處， 不容驕傲人欺壓我！
verses.en: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.zh: 我因盼望你的救恩 和你公義的話眼睛失明。
verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

verses.zh: 求你照你的慈愛待僕人， 將你的律例教訓我。
verses.en: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

verses.zh: 我是你的僕人，求你賜我悟性， 使我得知你的法度。
verses.en: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 這是耶和華降罰的時候， 因人廢了你的律法。
verses.en: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.

verses.zh: 所以，我愛你的命令勝於金子， 更勝於精金。
verses.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.zh: 你一切的訓詞，在萬事上我都以為正直； 我卻恨惡一切假道。
verses.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

verses.zh: 你的法度奇妙， 所以我一心謹守。
verses.en: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

verses.zh: 你的言語一解開就發出亮光， 使愚人通達。
verses.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

verses.zh: 我張口而氣喘， 因我切慕你的命令。
verses.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

verses.zh: 求你轉向我，憐憫我， 好像你素常待那些愛你名的人。
verses.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

verses.zh: 求你用你的話使我腳步穩當， 不許甚麼罪孽轄制我。
verses.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.zh: 求你救我脫離人的欺壓， 我要遵守你的訓詞。
verses.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

verses.zh: 求你用臉光照僕人， 又將你的律例教訓我。
verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

verses.zh: 我的眼淚下流成河， 因為他們不守你的律法。
verses.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你是公義的； 你的判語也是正直的！
verses.en: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.

verses.zh: 你所命定的法度是憑公義和至誠。
verses.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

verses.zh: 我心焦急，如同火燒， 因我敵人忘記你的言語。
verses.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

verses.zh: 你的話極其精煉， 所以你的僕人喜愛。
verses.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

verses.zh: 我微小，被人藐視， 卻不忘記你的訓詞。
verses.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

verses.zh: 你的公義永遠長存； 你的律法盡都真實。
verses.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

verses.zh: 我遭遇患難愁苦， 你的命令卻是我所喜愛的。
verses.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

verses.zh: 你的法度永遠是公義的； 求你賜我悟性，我就活了。
verses.en: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我一心呼籲你； 求你應允我，我必謹守你的律例！
verses.en: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.

verses.zh: 我向你呼籲，求你救我！ 我要遵守你的法度。
verses.en: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 我趁天未亮呼求； 我仰望了你的言語。
verses.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

verses.zh: 我趁夜更未換將眼睜開， 為要思想你的話語。
verses.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

verses.zh: 求你照你的慈愛聽我的聲音； 耶和華啊，求你照你的典章將我救活！
verses.en: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.zh: 追求奸惡的人臨近了； 他們遠離你的律法。
verses.en: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你與我相近； 你一切的命令盡都真實！
verses.en: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.

verses.zh: 我因[學]你的法度， 久已知道是你永遠立定的。
verses.en: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

verses.zh: 求你看顧我的苦難，搭救我， 因我不忘記你的律法。
verses.en: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.zh: 求你為我辨屈，救贖我， 照你的話將我救活。
verses.en: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

verses.zh: 救恩遠離惡人， 因為他們不尋求你的律例。
verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你的慈悲本為大； 求你照你的典章將我救活。
verses.en: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.

verses.zh: 逼迫我的，抵擋我的，很多， 我卻沒有偏離你的法度。
verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

verses.zh: 我看見奸惡的人就甚憎惡， 因為他們不遵守你的話。
verses.en: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

verses.zh: 你看我怎樣愛你的訓詞！ 耶和華啊，求你照你的慈愛將我救活！
verses.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.

verses.zh: 你話的總綱是真實； 你一切公義的典章是永遠長存。
verses.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

verses.zh: 首領無故地逼迫我， 但我的心畏懼你的言語。
verses.en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

verses.zh: 我喜愛你的話， 好像人得了許多擄物。
verses.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

verses.zh: 謊話是我所恨惡所憎嫌的； 惟你的律法是我所愛的。
verses.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

verses.zh: 我因你公義的典章一天七次讚美你。
verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.zh: 愛你律法的人有大平安， 甚麼都不能使他們絆腳。
verses.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我仰望了你的救恩， 遵行了你的命令。
verses.en: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

verses.zh: 我心裏守了你的法度； 這法度我甚喜愛。
verses.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.zh: 我遵守了你的訓詞和法度， 因我一切所行的都在你面前。
verses.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，願我的呼籲達到你面前， 照你的話賜我悟性。
verses.en: Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.

verses.zh: 願我的懇求達到你面前， 照你的話搭救我。
verses.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

verses.zh: 願我的嘴發出讚美的話， 因為你將律例教訓我。
verses.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

verses.zh: 願我的舌頭歌唱你的話， 因你一切的命令盡都公義。
verses.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

verses.zh: 願你用手幫助我， 因我揀選了你的訓詞。
verses.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，我切慕你的救恩！ 你的律法也是我所喜愛的。
verses.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.

verses.zh: 願我的性命存活，得以讚美你！ 願你的典章幫助我！
verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

verses.zh: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你尋找僕人， 因我不忘記你的命令。
verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

verses.zh: 上行（或譯登階，下同）之詩。 我在急難中求告耶和華， 他就應允我。
verses.en: In my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你救我脫離說謊的嘴唇和詭詐的舌頭！
verses.en: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.zh: 詭詐的舌頭啊，要給你甚麼呢？ 要拿甚麼加給你呢？
verses.en: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

verses.zh: 就是勇士的利箭和羅騰木 的炭火。
verses.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.zh: 我寄居在米設， 住在基達帳棚之中，有禍了！
verses.en: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.zh: 我與那恨惡和睦的人許久同住。
verses.en: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

verses.zh: 我願和睦， 但我發言，他們就要爭戰。
verses.en: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 我要向山舉目； 我的幫助從何而來？
verses.en: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

verses.zh: 我的幫助 從造天地的耶和華而來。
verses.en: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

verses.zh: 他必不叫你的腳搖動； 保護你的必不打盹！
verses.en: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.zh: 保護以色列的， 也不打盹也不睡覺。
verses.en: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.zh: 保護你的是耶和華； 耶和華在你右邊蔭庇你。
verses.en: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.zh: 白日，太陽必不傷你； 夜間，月亮必不害你。
verses.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.zh: 耶和華要保護你，免受一切的災害； 他要保護你的性命。
verses.en: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.zh: 你出你入，耶和華要保護你， 從今時直到永遠。
verses.en: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

verses.zh: 大衛上行之詩。 人對我說：我們往耶和華的殿去， 我就歡喜。
verses.en: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.

verses.zh: 耶路撒冷啊， 我們的腳站在你的門內。
verses.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.zh: 耶路撒冷被建造， 如同連絡整齊的一座城。
verses.en: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.zh: 眾支派，就是耶和華的支派，上那裏去， 按以色列的常例稱讚耶和華的名。
verses.en: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

verses.zh: 因為在那裏設立審判的寶座， 就是大衛家的寶座。
verses.en: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.zh: 你們要為耶路撒冷求平安！ 耶路撒冷啊，愛你的人必然興旺！
verses.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.zh: 願你城中平安！ 願你宮內興旺！
verses.en: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.zh: 因我弟兄和同伴的緣故，我要說： 願平安在你中間！
verses.en: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

verses.zh: 因耶和華－我們上帝殿的緣故， 我要為你求福！
verses.en: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 坐在天上的[主]啊， 我向你舉目。
verses.en: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

verses.zh: 看哪，僕人的眼睛怎樣望主人的手， 使女的眼睛怎樣望主母的手， 我們的眼睛也照樣望耶和華－我們的上帝， 直到他憐憫我們。
verses.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你憐憫我們，憐憫我們！ 因為我們被藐視，已到極處。
verses.en: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.zh: 我們被那些安逸人的譏誚 和驕傲人的藐視，已到極處。
verses.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

verses.zh: 大衛上行之詩。 以色列人要說： 若不是耶和華幫助我們，
verses.en: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

verses.zh: 若不是耶和華幫助我們， 當人起來攻擊我們、
verses.en: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.zh: 向我們發怒的時候， 就把我們活活地吞了。
verses.en: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.zh: 那時，波濤必漫過我們， 河水必淹沒我們，
verses.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.zh: 狂傲的水必淹沒我們。
verses.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.zh: 耶和華是應當稱頌的！ 他沒有把我們當野食交給他們吞吃。
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.zh: 我們好像雀鳥，從捕鳥人的網羅裏逃脫； 網羅破裂，我們逃脫了。
verses.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.zh: 我們得幫助， 是在乎[倚靠]造天地之耶和華的名。
verses.en: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 倚靠耶和華的人 好像錫安山，永不動搖。
verses.en: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

verses.zh: 眾山怎樣圍繞耶路撒冷， 耶和華也照樣圍繞他的百姓， 從今時直到永遠。
verses.en: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.zh: 惡人的杖不常落在義人的分上， 免得義人伸手作惡。
verses.en: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你善待那些為善 和心裏正直的人。
verses.en: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

verses.zh: 至於那偏行彎曲道路的人， 耶和華必使他和作惡的人一同出去[受刑]。 願平安歸於以色列！
verses.en: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 當耶和華將那些被擄的帶回錫安的時候， 我們好像做夢的人。
verses.en: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

verses.zh: 我們滿口喜笑、 滿舌歡呼的時候， 外邦中就有人說： 耶和華為他們行了大事！
verses.en: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.zh: 耶和華果然為我們行了大事， 我們就歡喜。
verses.en: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你使我們被擄的人歸回， 好像南地的河水復流。
verses.en: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.

verses.zh: 流淚撒種的， 必歡呼收割！
verses.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.zh: 那帶種流淚出去的， 必要歡歡樂樂地帶禾捆回來！
verses.en: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

verses.zh: 所羅門上行之詩。 若不是耶和華建造房屋， 建造的人就枉然勞力； 若不是耶和華看守城池， 看守的人就枉然警醒。
verses.en: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.zh: 你們清晨早起，夜晚安歇， 吃勞碌得來的飯，本是枉然； 惟有耶和華所親愛的，必叫他安然睡覺。
verses.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.zh: 兒女是耶和華所賜的產業； 所懷的胎是他所給的賞賜。
verses.en: Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

verses.zh: 少年時[所生]的兒女 好像勇士手中的箭。
verses.en: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

verses.zh: 箭袋充滿的人便為有福； 他們在城門口和仇敵說話的時候， 必不至於羞愧。
verses.en: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 凡敬畏耶和華、 遵行他道的人便為有福！
verses.en: Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.

verses.zh: 你要吃勞碌得來的； 你要享福，事情順利。
verses.en: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.zh: 你妻子在你的內室，好像多結果子的葡萄樹； 你兒女圍繞你的桌子，好像橄欖栽子。
verses.en: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.zh: 看哪，敬畏耶和華的人必要這樣蒙福！
verses.en: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.

verses.zh: 願耶和華從錫安賜福給你！ 願你一生一世看見耶路撒冷的好處！
verses.en: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.zh: 願你看見你兒女的兒女！ 願平安歸於以色列！
verses.en: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 以色列當說：從我幼年以來， 敵人屢次苦害我，
verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

verses.zh: 從我幼年以來，敵人屢次苦害我， 卻沒有勝了我。
verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.zh: [如同]扶犂的在我背上扶犂而耕， 耕的犂溝甚長。
verses.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.zh: 耶和華是公義的； 他砍斷了惡人的繩索。
verses.en: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.zh: 願恨惡錫安的都蒙羞退後！
verses.en: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.zh: 願他們像房頂上的草， 未長成而枯乾，
verses.en: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

verses.zh: 收割的不夠一把， 捆禾的也不滿懷。
verses.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

verses.zh: 過路的也不說： 願耶和華所賜的福歸與你們！ 我們奉耶和華的名給你們祝福！
verses.en: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 耶和華啊，我從深處向你求告！
verses.en: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.

verses.zh: 主啊，求你聽我的聲音！ 願你側耳聽我懇求的聲音！
verses.en: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.zh: 主－耶和華啊，你若究察罪孽， 誰能站得住呢？
verses.en: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

verses.zh: 但在你有赦免之恩， 要叫人敬畏你。
verses.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

verses.zh: 我等候耶和華，我的心等候； 我也仰望他的話。
verses.en: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.zh: 我的心[等候]主， 勝於守夜的，[等候]天亮， [勝於]守夜的，[等候]天亮。
verses.en: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

verses.zh: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華！ 因他有慈愛，有豐盛的救恩。
verses.en: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.zh: 他必救贖以色列脫離一切的罪孽。
verses.en: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

verses.zh: 大衛上行之詩。 耶和華啊，我的心不狂傲， 我的眼不高大； 重大和測不透的事， 我也不敢行。
verses.en: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

verses.zh: 我的心平穩安靜， 好像斷過奶的孩子在他母親的懷中； 我的心在我裏面真像斷過奶的孩子。
verses.en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

verses.zh: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華， 從今時直到永遠！
verses.en: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 耶和華啊，求你記念大衛所受的一切苦難！
verses.en: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:

verses.zh: 他怎樣向耶和華起誓， 向雅各的大能者許願，
verses.en: How he sware unto the Lord, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

verses.zh: 說：我必不進我的帳幕， 也不上我的床榻；
verses.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.zh: 我不容我的眼睛睡覺， 也不容我的眼目打盹；
verses.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

verses.zh: 直等我為耶和華尋得所在， 為雅各的大能者尋得居所。
verses.en: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

verses.zh: 我們聽說[約櫃]在以法他， 我們在基列‧耶琳就尋見了。
verses.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.zh: 我們要進他的居所， 在他腳凳前下拜。
verses.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，求你興起， 和你有能力的[約]櫃同入安息之所！
verses.en: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.zh: 願你的祭司披上公義！ 願你的聖民歡呼！
verses.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

verses.zh: 求你因你僕人大衛的緣故， 不要厭棄你的受膏者！
verses.en: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

verses.zh: 耶和華向大衛、憑誠實起了誓， 必不反覆，[說]： 我要使你所生的 坐在你的寶座上。
verses.en: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.zh: 你的眾子若守我的約 和我所教訓他們的法度， 他們的子孫必永遠坐在你的寶座上。
verses.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

verses.zh: 因為耶和華揀選了錫安， 願意當作自己的居所，
verses.en: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

verses.zh: 說：這是我永遠安息之所； 我要住在這裏， 因為是我所願意的。
verses.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.zh: 我要使其中的糧食豐滿， 使其中的窮人飽足。
verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩， 聖民大聲歡呼！
verses.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.zh: 我要叫大衛的角在那裏發生； 我為我的受膏者預備明燈。
verses.en: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

verses.zh: 我要使他的仇敵披上羞恥； 但他的冠冕要在頭上發光。
verses.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

verses.zh: 大衛上行之詩。 看哪，弟兄和睦同居 是何等地善，何等地美！
verses.en: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.zh: 這好比那貴重的油[澆]在亞倫的頭上， 流到鬍鬚，又流到他的衣襟；
verses.en: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

verses.zh: 又好比黑門的甘露降在錫安山； 因為在那裏有耶和華所命定的福， 就是永遠的生命。
verses.en: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

verses.zh: 上行之詩。 耶和華的僕人夜間站在耶和華殿中的， 你們當稱頌耶和華！
verses.en: Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.

verses.zh: 你們當向聖所舉手， 稱頌耶和華！
verses.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.

verses.zh: 願造天地的耶和華， 從錫安賜福給你們！
verses.en: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

verses.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 你們要讚美耶和華的名！ 耶和華的僕人站在耶和華殿中； 站在我們上帝殿院中的，你們要讚美他！
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.
Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 耶和華本為善； 要歌頌他的名， 因為這是美好的。
verses.en: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

verses.zh: 耶和華揀選雅各歸自己， 揀選以色列特作自己的子民。
verses.en: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

verses.zh: 原來我知道耶和華為大， 也知道我們的主超乎萬神之上。
verses.en: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.zh: 耶和華在天上，在地下， 在海中，在一切的深處， 都隨自己的意旨而行。
verses.en: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.zh: 他使雲霧從地極上騰， 造電隨雨而閃， 從府庫中帶出風來。
verses.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.zh: 他將埃及頭生的， 連人帶牲畜都擊殺了。
verses.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

verses.zh: 埃及啊，他施行神蹟奇事， 在你當中，在法老和他一切臣僕身上。
verses.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

verses.zh: 他擊殺許多的民， 又殺戮大能的王，
verses.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.zh: 就是亞摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩， 並迦南一切的國王，
verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

verses.zh: 將他們的地賞賜他的百姓以色列為業。
verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.zh: 耶和華啊，你的名存到永遠！ 耶和華啊，你可記念的名存到萬代！
verses.en: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.

verses.zh: 耶和華要為他的百姓伸冤， 為他的僕人後悔。
verses.en: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.zh: 外邦的偶像是金的，銀的， 是人手所造的；
verses.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.zh: 有口卻不能言， 有眼卻不能看，
verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.zh: 有耳卻不能聽， 口中也沒有氣息。
